info.description:
⚠️ Important Notice

The following fields will be deprecated from our Custom Integration APIs starting 30th September 2025 11:59 PM UTC :
• The “order_items” field in the Get Seller Orders API response when using the query parameter include=order_items.
We recommend you review and update your custom integrations to ensure they're compatible with these changes.

Welcome to Omniful’s API Documentation 🚀

We’ve written this documentation to help developers and Omniful users seamlessly integrate and deploy Custom Integrations using our API with ease. With these APIs, you can access and manage most of the features available on your Omniful dashboard.

For ease of use, we have documented all API endpoints, including their required parameters, example requests, and responses, which you can find on the right side in the form of code snippets. The quickest way to get started with our APIs is by clicking the “Run in Postman” button above.

Postman is a free tool that simplifies API testing and debugging.

Omniful’s APIs follow RESTful architecture and utilize standard HTTP methods. Our APIs accept and return data in JSON encoded body, ensuring a consistent and developer-friendly experience.

Refer to the following sections for a step-by-step guide on integrating Omniful’s APIs into your system. 🚀

Getting Started

First, you need to have an integration in your Omniful dashboard.

  1. Log in to your Omniful dashboard.

  2. Navigate to Settings → Apps & Integrations → Custom Apps → Seller Custom Integration / Tenant Custom Integration → Custom (+).

  3. Once completed, you’ll receive the required API credentials for authentication.

📹 Watch our short video guide on setting up Custom Integrations: Video Link

📕API Documentation and API Usage Guidelines

📘 Overview

Our APIs support standard HTTP methods:

  • GET – Retrieve data.

  • POST – Create a new record.

  • PATCH – Update specific record fields.

  • PUT – Update the entire record.

You can import and test our complete API collection in Postman by clicking the “Run in Postman” button.

⚠ Note: Any API requests made with valid credentials will directly affect real-time data in your Omniful custom integration. Please exercise caution when making changes.

🔑 Authentication

All API requests must be authenticated using a Bearer Token. Include your token in the Authorization header as follows:
Authorization: Bearer

🌍 Base URLs

Use the following base URLs for staging and production, depending on your environment:

  • Staging: https://api.staging.omniful.com

  • Production: https://prodapi.omniful.com

🔄 Request & Response Formats

  • All API requests and responses follow the JSON format.

  • Each API is documented with example request and response payloads for both successful and failed calls.

⚡ Rate Limiting

To ensure fair usage and performance stability, Omniful APIs have a default rate limit of:

✅ 60 requests per minute for Seller and Sales Channel APIs

✅ 120 requests per minute for Tenant APIs

📌 Exceeding the limit may result in temporary API restrictions.

🔔 Webhooks: Get Real-Time Updates

Omniful supports webhooks for real-time event notifications. Whenever an event (e.g., order update, shipment creation) occurs, Omniful will send a POST request to your webhook URL.

✅ How to Set Up a Webhook

  1. Log in to your Omniful Dashboard.

  2. Navigate to Settings → Apps & Integrations → Custom Apps → Seller Custom Integration/Tenant Custom Integration → Configurations Tab → Webhook URLs.

  3. Add your Webhook URL and enable the toggle.

  4. Click Save to apply changes.

Webhook Specifications:

  • Method: POST

  • Content-Type Header: application/json

  • Response: Must be set to return **HTTP 200 Code**Only

📌 Ensure your webhook URL is always reachable to avoid missing important updates.

Please click Here to view Sample Webhook Payload

🔄 API Functionality & Button Status

Some API functions depend on specific settings in your Omniful dashboard.

For example:

  • If the “Order Sync” button is disabled, API calls related to order sync will return an error.

  • Ensure that all required settings are enabled in the dashboard to successfully fetch data from the APIs.

⏱ Timestamp Format

All timestamps in API requests, responses, and webhooks are returned in UTC (ISO 8601 format) unless explicitly stated otherwise.# Cursor Pagination

➤ V2 Cursor-based paginated APIs

These APIs use cursor-based pagination.

Pagination metadata is returned inside the meta object:

{
  "meta": {
    "has_previous_page": false,
    "has_next_page": true,
    "start_cursor": "Q0xjREdna3AybHBISzU0QkFBQWlEbG9NYWdiN3ZmdTAzNncxS3NKZw==",
    "end_cursor": "Q0J3YUNTbHR0SC9XbkFFQUFDSU9XZ3hwcjc1alN4Uk9Vem1wYUc4PQ=="
  }
}

➤ Cursor-based Pagination

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Description
per_page integer Number of records to return
search_after string Fetch records after the provided cursor
search_before string Fetch records before the provided cursor

Only one of search_after or search_before should be provided.

Pagination Fields

Field Description
has_next_page Indicates whether more records exist after the current page
has_previous_page Indicates whether records exist before the current page
start_cursor Cursor representing the first item in the current page
end_cursor Cursor representing the last item in the current page

Pagination Flow

Action Cursor To Use
Next page end_cursor → search_after
Previous page start_cursor → search_before

Important Notes

  • Cursor values are opaque and must not be modified.

  • Results are returned in a deterministic order.

  • Avoid using both search_after and search_before together.

request.description:
📌 Create Order API Overview

The Create Order API allows users to place new orders in Omniful by providing order details, customer information, shipping and billing addresses, invoice details, and payment information.

📝 Request Body Parameters

Key Data Type Description Required
order_id string Must be a globally unique identifier for the order (e.g., "order_0008"). Cannot be reused if the order is deleted. ✅ Yes
order_alias string Secondary identifier for tracking in external systems (e.g., ERP or warehouse systems). ❌ No
hub_code string Code for the warehouse/fulfillment center that will handle this order. Ensure it matches a valid hub in your system. ✅ Yes
order_items object Array of items in this order. Must contain at least one item with complete product and pricing details. ✅ Yes
order_items.sku_code string Product’s unique SKU identifier, must match exactly with the product catalog. ✅ Yes
order_items.name string Product display name, used in the order summary and customer communications. ❌ No
order_items.display_price number Original product price before discounts. Used to show savings to the customer. ❌ No
order_items.selling_price number Final price charged after base discounts. Used for order calculations. ✅ Yes
order_items.is_substituted boolean Set to true if this is a substitution for the customer's original choice. Helps track substitutions. ❌ No
order_items.quantity integer Number of units ordered. Must be at least 1. Affects all price calculations. ✅ Yes
order_items.tax_percent number Tax rate for this item (e.g., 10 for 10%). Used to calculate the tax amount. ❌ No
order_items.tax number Calculated tax for this line item based on the selling price and quantity. ❌ No
order_items.unit_price number Price per unit, base price used for quantity calculations. ❌ No
order_items.subtotal number Line item total before tax and special discounts (unit_price × quantity). ❌ No
order_items.total number Final amount for the line item including all taxes and discounts. ❌ No
order_items.discount number Total discount applied to this item. ❌ No
order_items.tax_inclusive boolean If true, prices include tax. Important for tax calculations. ❌ No
billing_address object Address used for billing and tax calculations. Must be a valid physical address. ✅ Yes
billing_address.address1 string Main address line (street number and name). ✅ Yes
billing_address.address2 string Additional address details like apartment number, floor, or landmarks. ❌ No
billing_address.city string City name. Must be valid for the given state and country. ✅ Yes
billing_address.country string Full country name. Must match with country_code provided. ✅ Yes
billing_address.first_name string First name of the billing contact person. ❌ No
billing_address.last_name string Last name of the billing contact person. ❌ No
billing_address.phone string Contact number for billing issues. ❌ No
billing_address.state string Full state name. Must be valid for the given country. ❌ No
billing_address.zip string Postal code for the address. ❌ No
billing_address.area string Optional area name ❌ No
billing_address.street string Optional street name ❌ No
billing_address.district string Optional district name ❌ No
billing_address.state_code string Standard state/province code (e.g., "RIY" for Riyadh). ❌ No
billing_address.country_code string Two-letter ISO country code (e.g., "SA" for Saudi Arabia). ❌ No
billing_address.latitude number Optional GPS latitude for precise location. ❌ No
billing_address.longitude number Optional GPS longitude for precise location. ❌ No
billing_address.national_address_code string National address code of billing address. ❌ No
shipping_address object Delivery address where the order will be sent. ✅ Yes
shipping_address.address1 string Primary delivery address. Must be accurate for successful delivery. ✅ Yes
shipping_address.address2 string Extra delivery instructions or landmark details. ❌ No
shipping_address.city string Delivery city. Must be within serviceable area. ✅ Yes
shipping_address.country string Delivery country name. Must match with your shipping rules. ✅ Yes
shipping_address.first_name string First name of person receiving delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.last_name string Last name of person receiving delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.phone string Contact number for delivery updates. ❌ No
shipping_address.state string Full state name for delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.zip string Postal code for delivery location. ❌ No
shipping_address.area string Optional area name ❌ No
shipping_address.street string Optional street name ❌ No
shipping_address.district string Optional district name ❌ No
shipping_address.state_code string Standard state code for delivery location. ❌ No
shipping_address.country_code string Two-letter country code for delivery location. ❌ No
shipping_address.latitude number Optional GPS latitude for precise location. ❌ No
shipping_address.longitude number Optional GPS longitude for precise location. ❌ No
shipping_address.national_address_code string National address code of shipping address. ❌ No
invoice object Contains all financial details and calculations for the order. ✅ Yes
invoice.currency string Three-letter currency code (e.g., "USD", "SAR"). ✅ Yes
invoice.subtotal number Sum of all item prices before tax/discounts. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_price number Delivery fee charged to customer. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_refund number Any shipping fee refunded to customer. ❌ No
invoice.tax number Total tax amount for the order. ❌ No
invoice.discount number Total order level discounts (not including item discounts). ❌ No
invoice.total number Final order amount including all items, tax, shipping, and discounts. ✅ Yes
invoice.total_paid number Amount already received from customer. ❌ No
invoice.total_due number Remaining amount to be paid. Should be 0 for prepaid orders. ❌ No
invoice.total_refunded number Total amount refunded to customer from this order. ❌ No
invoice.payment_mode string How the customer paid (e.g., "visa", "cash","mada", "credit card"). ❌ No
invoice.tax_percent number Overall tax rate applied to order. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_tax number Tax amount specifically for the shipping fee. ❌ No
invoice.sub_total_tax_inclusive boolean Whether subtotal includes tax. ❌ No
invoice.sub_total_discount_inclusive boolean Whether subtotal includes discounts. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_tax_inclusive boolean Whether shipping fee includes tax. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_discount_inclusive boolean Whether shipping fee includes discounts. ❌ No
customer object Details about who placed the order. ✅ Yes
customer.id string Unique identifier for this customer in your system. ✅ Yes
customer.first_name string Customer's first name. ✅ Yes
customer.last_name string Customer's last name. ❌ No
customer.mobile string Mobile number for updates. ❌ No
customer.mobile_code string Country calling code with + prefix. ❌ No
customer.email string Customer’s email for order confirmations. ❌ No
customer.avatar string URL to customer’s profile image. ❌ No
customer.gender string Customer's gender, if provided. ❌ No
labels array Custom tags to categorize the order. ❌ No
slot object Selected delivery time window. ❌ No
slot.delivery_date string Delivery date in DDMMYYYY format. ❌ No
slot.start_time integer Delivery window start time in HHMM format. ❌ No
slot.end_time integer Delivery window end time in HHMM format. ❌ No
payment_method string Payment method chosen (e.g., "prepaid", "postpaid","pending"). ✅ Yes
delivery_type string Delivery Types supported. (e.g., click_and_collect,
express_delivery,
slot_delivery,
normal_delivery)		 ❌ No
transactions array List of payment transactions for this order. ❌ No
transactions.transaction_id string Unique transaction ID. ❌ No
transactions.amount number Transaction amount. ❌ No
transactions.type integer Transaction type code (e.g., 1=payment, 2=refund). ❌ No
transactions.card_number string Masked card number. ❌ No
transactions.source_account string Source account for payment. ❌ No
transactions.destination_account string Destination account receiving payment. ❌ No
transactions.status integer Payment status code (e.g., 1=success, 0=pending). ❌ No
transactions.description string Human-readable explanation of the transaction. ❌ No
is_cash_on_delivery boolean Set to true if payment is collected during delivery. ✅ Yes
note string Special instructions for order handling. ❌ No
type string Order category (e.g., "b2b", "b2c"). ✅ Yes
external_fields array Custom fields for external system integration. ❌ No
external_fields.key string Custom field name for external systems. ❌ No
external_fields.value string Custom field value. ❌ No
cancel_order_after_seconds integer Order auto-cancels after this many seconds. ❌ No
shipment.shipping_method string shipping method of the order ❌ No
attachments array List of attachments associated with the order or invoice. Each attachment should include file metadata and a publicly accessible file URL. ❌ No
attachments[].name string Display name of the attachment. ✅ Yes
attachments[].description string Short description of the attachment content. ❌ No
attachments[].url string Publicly accessible URL of the uploaded file. ✅ Yes
attachments[].mime_type string MIME type of the file, for example image/jpeg or application/pdf. ✅ Yes
attachments[].entity string Entity the attachment belongs to, such as order or invoice. ✅ Yes

✅ Notes

  • Fields marked as ✅ Yes under "Required" must be included in the request.

  • Geolocation fields (latitude, longitude) are optional but useful for delivery tracking.

  • The payment_method should match an accepted payment type in the system.

  • Ensure customer.id is valid if using an existing customer, or create a new customer by passing the required fields.

  • The order_items array must contain at least one item to process the order.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1️⃣ How do I force an order to a specific hub?

To manually route an order to a specific hub, provide the hub's unique code in the hub_code field.

Example: { "hub_code": "HUB123" }

2️⃣ What if payment details are missing?

If payment information is unavailable and you need to block shipment creation at the packing stage, set:
{ "payment_method": "pending" }

This ensures the shipment cannot be created until payment details are updated.

3️⃣ How do I create a shipment if the payment status is pending?

  • Set the payment status to "pending" when creating the order.

  • Once the invoice details are received, update the order using the Update Order Invoice API.

  • After updating the invoice, shipment creation will be enabled via the dashboard.

request.description:
📌 Update Order API - Overview

The Update Order API allows users to modify the details of an existing order that was previously placed. This API can be used to update various order attributes, such as order items, shipping details, billing information, and customer details.

Users can update an order only if it is not in the "packed" state. Once an order reaches the packed stage, further modifications using this API are restricted.

This API ensures flexibility in managing orders before final processing while maintaining data integrity after packing.

Note: The note field is always treated as part of the update. If the note key is included in the payload with an empty value or if the note key is not provided at all, it will be treated as an update with an empty note, resulting in the deletion of any previously saved note.

📝 Request Body Parameters

Field Data Type Description Required
order_id string The ID of the order you want to update. You can't change this value. Example: "order_0003". ✅ Yes
hub_code string The warehouse handling this order. Example: "Shubhra001". ✅ Yes
order_items array List of products in the order. You can update quantities, add or remove items. ✅ Yes
order_items.sku_code string The product's unique ID in your catalog. Ensure it exists before using it. ✅ Yes
order_items.name string The name that appears on the order for this product. ❌ No
order_items.display_price number The original price before any discounts. ❌ No
order_items.selling_price number The actual price charged for this item after basic discounts. ✅ Yes
order_items.is_substituted boolean Set to true if replacing the original item with something else. ❌ No
order_items.quantity integer How many of this item you want now. Must be 1 or more. ❌ No
order_items.tax_percent number The tax rate for this item (e.g., 10 for 10%). ❌ No
order_items.tax number The calculated tax amount for this item based on quantity and price. ❌ No
order_items.unit_price number Price per unit of the item. ❌ No
order_items.subtotal number Total cost before tax (unit_price × quantity). ❌ No
order_items.total number Final price including everything (tax, discounts, etc.). ❌ No
order_items.discount number How much discount is applied to this item. ❌ No
order_items.tax_inclusive boolean Set to true if prices include tax. ❌ No
billing_address.address1 string Main billing street address. ❌ No
billing_address.city string City for billing. ❌ No
billing_address.country string Country for billing. ❌ No
billing_address.first_name string First name of the person being billed. ❌ No
billing_address.last_name string Last name of the person being billed. ❌ No
billing_address.phone string Phone number for billing questions. ❌ No
billing_address.state string State for billing. ❌ No
billing_address.zip string ZIP or postal code for billing. ❌ No
billing_address.state_code string Short code for the state (e.g., "NY" for New York). ❌ No
billing_address.country_code string Two-letter country code (e.g., "US" for United States). ❌ No
billing_address.latitude number Latitude for the address, if needed. ❌ No
billing_address.longitude number Longitude for the address, if needed. ❌ No
billing_address.national_address_code string National address code of billing address. ❌ No
shipping_address.address1 string Main delivery address. ❌ No
shipping_address.city string City for delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.country string Country for delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.first_name string First name of the person receiving the package. ❌ No
shipping_address.last_name string Last name of the person receiving the package. ❌ No
shipping_address.phone string Phone number to call for delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.state string State for delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.zip string ZIP or postal code for delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.state_code string Short code for the delivery state. ❌ No
shipping_address.country_code string Two-letter code for delivery country. ❌ No
shipping_address.latitude number Latitude for delivery location, if needed. ❌ No
shipping_address.longitude number Longitude for delivery location, if needed. ❌ No
shipping_address.national_address_code string National address code of shipping address. ❌ No
order_created_at string The order’s creation time. Cannot be changed. ❌ No
invoice.currency string Currency used for the order (e.g., "USD"). Cannot be changed after creation. ❌ No
invoice.subtotal number Total cost of all items before any extras. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_price number Delivery charge. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_refund number Refund for shipping issues. ❌ No
invoice.tax number Total tax for the entire order. ❌ No
invoice.discount number Total discount applied to the order. ❌ No
invoice.total number Final total amount, including everything. ❌ No
invoice.total_paid number Total amount already received. ❌ No
invoice.total_due number Remaining amount to be paid. ❌ No
invoice.total_refunded number Total refunded to the customer. ❌ No
invoice.payment_mode string How the customer paid (e.g., "visa", "cash","mada", "credit card"). ❌ No
invoice.tax_percent number Overall tax rate applied to the order. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_tax number Tax applied to the shipping cost. ❌ No
invoice.sub_total_tax_inclusive boolean Whether subtotal includes tax. ❌ No
invoice.sub_total_discount_inclusive boolean Whether subtotal includes discounts. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_tax_inclusive boolean Whether shipping includes tax. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_discount_inclusive boolean Whether shipping includes discounts. ❌ No
customer.first_name string Customer’s first name. ❌ No
customer.last_name string Customer’s last name. ❌ No
customer.mobile string Customer’s phone number without country code. ❌ No
customer.mobile_code string Country code for the phone (e.g., "+1" for US). ❌ No
customer.email string Customer’s email for order updates. ❌ No
customer.avatar string Link to customer’s profile picture. ❌ No
customer.gender string Customer’s gender, if provided. ❌ No
shipment.shipping_partner_name string Delivery company name. ❌ No
shipment.shipping_partner_tag string Internal code for the delivery company. ❌ No
shipment.awb_number string Tracking number for the package. ❌ No
shipment.awb_label string Link to download the shipping label. ❌ No
shipment.tracking_link string Link for customers to track their package. ❌ No
labels array Tags to categorize the order (e.g., ["urgent", "fragile"]). ❌ No
payment_method string Payment method used (e.g., "prepaid", "postpaid","pending"). ❌ No
is_cash_on_delivery boolean Set true if cash is collected on delivery. ❌ No
note string Special instructions or comments for the order. ❌ No
external_fields array Custom fields for system integration. ❌ No
external_fields.key string Name of the custom field. ❌ No
external_fields.value string Value of the custom field. ❌ No
cancel_order_after_seconds integer Auto-cancel the order after this many seconds. Use 0 for never auto-cancel. ❌ No

⚠ Key Points to Consider When Updating Orders

  • Only orders with the status "on_hold" can be updated.

  • Ensure all required fields are correctly formatted before submitting the update request.

📌 Update Order Invoice API - Overview

The Update Order Invoice API allows users to modify the invoice details of a previously placed order. This API is useful when adjustments or modifications are required in the invoice amount, tax details, discounts, payment information, or other financial components of an order.

Users can use this API to ensure that the invoice reflects the correct pricing and charges before final processing or fulfillment.

To successfully update an invoice, all the fields from both the order_items and invoice objects are required.

📝 Request Body Parameters

Field Data Type Description Required
order_items array Array of items to update in the order invoice. ✅ Yes
order_items.sku_code string Product's SKU identifier that needs invoice update. ❌ No
order_items.display_price number Original advertised price shown to customer. ❌ No
order_items.selling_price number Actual selling price after base discounts. ❌ No
order_items.tax_percent number Tax percentage applied to the item. ❌ No
order_items.tax number Calculated tax amount for the item. ❌ No
order_items.unit_price number Base price per unit excluding tax. ❌ No
order_items.total number Total price including tax for this item. ❌ No
order_items.tax_inclusive boolean Whether the item price includes tax. ❌ No
invoice.currency string Three-letter currency code (e.g., "USD"). ✅ Yes
invoice.subtotal number Sum of all items before adjustments. ✅ Yes
invoice.shipping_price number Cost of shipping. ✅ Yes
invoice.shipping_refund number Amount refunded for shipping. ❌ No
invoice.tax number Total tax amount for the order. ✅ Yes
invoice.tax_percent number Overall tax percentage applied. ❌ No
invoice.discount number Total discount applied to order. ❌ No
invoice.total number Final total after all adjustments. ✅ Yes
invoice.total_paid number Amount already paid by customer. ❌ No
invoice.total_due number Remaining amount to be paid. ❌ No
invoice.total_refunded number Total amount refunded to customer. ❌ No
invoice.payment_mode string How the customer paid (e.g., "visa", "cash","mada", "credit card"). ❌ No
invoice.loyalty_discount number Discount applied from loyalty points. ❌ No
invoice.wallet_amount number Amount paid from customer wallet. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_tax number Tax applied to shipping cost. ❌ No
invoice.sub_total_tax_inclusive boolean Whether subtotal includes tax. ❌ No
invoice.sub_total_discount_inclusive boolean Whether subtotal includes discounts. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_tax_inclusive boolean Whether shipping price includes tax. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_discount_inclusive boolean Whether shipping price includes discounts. ❌ No
invoice.additional_charges array List of any additional charges applied. ✅ Yes
invoice.refunded_amounts array List of all refund transactions. ✅ Yes

Validation Notes

order_id string Yes The unique identifier of the order whose attachments need to be updated.

Request Body

Field Type Required Description
attachments array Yes List of attachments to associate with the order.
attachments[].name string Yes Display name of the attachment.
attachments[].description string No Optional description for the attachment.
attachments[].url string Yes Public or accessible URL of the attachment file.
attachments[].mime_type string Yes MIME type of the file, such as image/jpeg or application/pdf.
attachments[].entity string Yes Logical entity the attachment belongs to, can be one of order or invoice .

request.description:
📌 Get Seller Order by Order ID API - Overview

The Get Seller Order by Order ID API allows users to fetch details of a single order for a seller using the Omniful-generated Order ID (omniful_order_id).

This API is particularly useful for retrieving order details that were not placed through the Custom Sales Channel Integration. It provides complete order information, including order items, customer details, billing and shipping addresses, and invoice details, ensuring sellers have full visibility into individual orders placed through any of the sales channels they have integrated on their account.

🔹 Key Information

  • omniful_order_id is unique and generated by Omniful for every order.

  • This is different from the order ID received from the sales channel.

  • If a seller has multiple sales channels connected, the same sales channel order ID may appear in different channels. However, the Omniful Order ID remains unique across all orders.

  • Using omniful_order_id ensures accurate order retrieval without conflicts.

request.description:
📌 Get Order Logs API – Overview

The Get Order Logs API allows users to retrieve detailed logs for a specific order using its Order ID.

It provides real-time insights into the order’s lifecycle within the warehouse, including:

  • Status updates

  • Fulfillment progress

  • Modifications made to the order

This API is particularly useful for:

  • Tracking order history

  • Troubleshooting operational issues

  • Ensuring seamless order management

Response Body Parameters

Field Data Type Description Always Included
is_success boolean Indicates whether the request was successful ✅ Yes
status_code number HTTP status code of the response ✅ Yes
data object Contains the order log information ✅ Yes
data.logs array List of order event logs ✅ Yes
data.logs[].event string Type of event that occurred (e.g., "New Order", "Hub Assigned") ✅ Yes
data.logs[].event_updated_by string Name or identifier of the user/system that made the update ✅ Yes
data.logs[].event_updated_at string Timestamp of when the event occurred, in the format MMM DD, YYYY HH:mm:ss AM/PM ✅ Yes
data.logs[].note string Additional comments or information about the event ✅ Yes
meta object Additional metadata about the response ❌ No

Important Notes

Event Types

  • New Order – Initial order creation

  • Hub Assigned – Order assigned to a fulfillment center

  • In Picking – Items being collected from the warehouse

  • Picked – All items collected successfully

  • In Packing – Items being prepared for shipping

  • Additional status updates may also be available

Time Format

  • All timestamps follow a 12-hour format with AM/PM

  • Example: "Oct 12, 2024 04:30:38 AM"

  • Includes date, hours, minutes, and seconds

Event Sources

  • User-generated events display the user’s name (e.g., "Ritik", "RishabhL")

  • System-generated events display "System" as the updater

  • Every event maintains a complete audit trail

Log Structure

  • Logs are ordered chronologically (newest first)

  • Each log entry contains full event details

  • The note field may be an empty string if no comments are provided

Status Codes

  • 200 – Successfully retrieved logs

  • 401 – Unauthorized

  • 403 – Insufficient permissions

  • 404 – Order not found

item.description:
📦 Orders API Documentation

The Orders API allows you to create, fetch, update, and manage orders within the Omniful platform. This API resource provides comprehensive details on order structures, including order items, billing, shipping, transactions, delivery schedules, and payment details. You can use the API to handle all aspects of order processing for your custom sales channels.

🛒 Order Resource (orders)

This resource is used to define an order in the system and its associated metadata.

Field Type Description
order_id string Unique identifier for the order (must always be unique).
order_alias string Alias for easy reference of the order.
hub_code string Code for the hub associated with the order.

📦 Order Items (orders.order_items)

The order_items array contains objects representing each item in the order. Each item includes product details, prices, quantities, and taxes.

Field Type Description
sku_code string Unique SKU identifier for the item.
hs_code string HS Code for product classification in international trade.
sku_id string Unique identifier for the SKU used for internal reference.
name string Name of the item.
display_price number Display price of the item.
selling_price number Final selling price of the item.
is_substituted boolean Indicates if the item has been substituted with an alternative SKU (true/false).
substitute_seller_sku_codes array List of the SKU codes for substitute items offered by the seller.
serialised_sku_codes array List of serial numbers for inventory control.
item_barcodes string Barcode used for scanning and quick identification.
quantity integer Quantity of the item in the order.
picked_quantity integer Quantity of the items picked in the order.
packed_quantity integer Quantity of the items packed in the order.
unit_price number Unit price of the item.
subtotal number Subtotal before tax and discounts (unit price * quantity).
total number Total amount after tax & discounts (subtotal + tax - discount).
discount number Discount applied to the item.
tax_percent number Tax percentage applied to the item.
tax number Tax amount calculated based on the tax percentage.
tax_inclusive boolean Indicates if the tax is included in the price.

🏠 Shipping & Billing Address (orders.shipping_address & orders.billing_address)

These objects contain the shipping and billing details for the order. Both follow the same structure. If no billing address is provided, it will be considered the same as the shipping address.

Field Type Description
address1 string First line of the address.
address2 string Second line of the address (optional).
city string City of the address.
state string State or province.
state_code string State abbreviation.
country string Country name.
country_code string ISO country code (e.g., US, SA).
zip string ZIP or postal code.
latitude number Geographical latitude.
longitude number Geographical longitude.
first_name string First name of the person.
last_name string Last name of the person.
phone string Contact phone number.
country_calling_code string Country calling code (e.g., +966, +90).

🧾 Invoice (orders.invoice)

This object contains the billing and payment details related to the order.

Field Type Description
currency string Currency code (e.g., USD, SAR).
subtotal number Total before taxes & discounts.
shipping_price number Cost of shipping.
shipping_refund number Refund amount for shipping (if applicable).
tax number Tax amount calculated based on tax percentage.
discount number Total discount applied to the order.
total number Final amount after taxes & discounts.
total_paid number Amount already paid.
total_due number Remaining amount to be paid.
total_refunded number Total refunded amount.
payment_mode string Payment method (e.g., Mada, Credit Card).
payment_method string Payment state (prepaid, postpaid, pending).
is_cash_on_delivery boolean Indicates if cash on delivery is used.
tax_percent number Tax percentage applied.
shipping_tax number Tax on shipping cost.
sub_total_tax_inclusive boolean Indicates if the subtotal includes tax.
sub_total_discount_inclusive boolean Indicates if the subtotal includes discounts.
shipping_tax_inclusive boolean Indicates if the shipping cost includes tax.
shipping_discount_inclusive boolean Indicates if the shipping cost includes discounts.
attachments array List of associated attachment files.
attachments[].url string URL of the attachment (e.g., https://example.com/avatar1.jpg).
attachments[].type string Type of the attachment (e.g., image1, image2, image3).

👤 Customer (orders.customer)

Stores the customer details associated with the order. The system auto-fetches these details if a customer ID is provided. If not, you can manually enter the details.

Field Type Description
id string Customer ID (auto-fetches details if provided).
first_name string Customer's first name.
last_name string Customer's last name.
mobile string Mobile number.
mobile_code string Country code for mobile.
email string Email address.
gender string Gender (male, female, other).
country string Country of the customer.
country_code string Country code of the customer.
country_calling_code string Country's international calling code (e.g., +966, +90).
avatar string URL of the customer's profile picture.

🚚 Shipment Type (orders.shipment_type)

Defines the type of shipment for the order.

Type Description
omniful_generated Omniful Generated Shipment: Shipments created manually or automatically by Omniful.
sales_channel_generated Sales Channel Generated Shipment: Shipments generated by the sales channel system.

🚛 Delivery Type (orders.delivery_type)

Specifies the delivery method for an order.

Type Description
click_and_collect The order will be prepared for collection by the customer at a designated location.
express_delivery The order will be delivered to the customer on an expedited basis.
slot_delivery The order will be delivered within a specific time slot chosen by the customer.
normal_delivery The order will be delivered using the standard delivery method.

💳 Transaction Details (orders.transactions)

An array of transaction objects, each representing a single transaction.

Field Type Description
transaction_id string A unique identifier for the transaction (e.g., "T123456").
amount number The monetary value of the transaction (e.g., 100.50).
type integer Type of transaction (1: Coupon, 2: Coin, 3: Gift Card, 4: Account).
card_number string The masked card number used for the transaction (e.g., "411111**1111").
source_account string The account from which the transaction originates.
destination_account string The account receiving the transaction.
status integer Current state of the transaction (1: Pending, 2: Completed, 3: Failed).
description string A brief note about the transaction (e.g., "Payment for order #12345").

🌍 External Fields (order.external_fields)

Allows adding custom order data as key-value pairs.

Field Type Description
key string External field name.
value string External field value.

⏳ Order Auto-Cancellation (order.cancel_order_after_seconds)

Defines the time (in seconds) after which the order will automatically cancel if it is in the on_hold state.

Field Type Description
cancel_order_after_seconds int Time (in seconds) after which the order will be automatically canceled if it's on hold.

item.description:
📦 Orders API Documentation

The Orders API allows you to create, fetch, update, and manage orders within the Omniful platform. This API resource provides comprehensive details on order structures, including order items, billing, shipping, transactions, delivery schedules, and payment details. You can use the API to handle all aspects of order processing for your custom sales channels.

🛒 Order Resource (orders)

This resource is used to define an order in the system and its associated metadata.

Field Type Description
order_id string Unique identifier for the order (must always be unique).
order_alias string Alias for easy reference of the order.
hub_code string Code for the hub associated with the order.

📦 Order Items (orders.order_items)

The order_items array contains objects representing each item in the order. Each item includes product details, prices, quantities, and taxes.

Field Type Description
sku_code string Unique SKU identifier for the item.
hs_code string HS Code for product classification in international trade.
sku_id string Unique identifier for the SKU used for internal reference.
name string Name of the item.
display_price number Display price of the item.
selling_price number Final selling price of the item.
is_substituted boolean Indicates if the item has been substituted with an alternative SKU (true/false).
substitute_seller_sku_codes array List of the SKU codes for substitute items offered by the seller.
serialised_sku_codes array List of serial numbers for inventory control.
item_barcodes string Barcode used for scanning and quick identification.
quantity integer Quantity of the item in the order.
picked_quantity integer Quantity of the items picked in the order.
packed_quantity integer Quantity of the items packed in the order.
unit_price number Unit price of the item.
subtotal number Subtotal before tax and discounts (unit price * quantity).
total number Total amount after tax & discounts (subtotal + tax - discount).
discount number Discount applied to the item.
tax_percent number Tax percentage applied to the item.
tax number Tax amount calculated based on the tax percentage.
tax_inclusive boolean Indicates if the tax is included in the price.

🏠 Shipping & Billing Address (orders.shipping_address & orders.billing_address)

These objects contain the shipping and billing details for the order. Both follow the same structure. If no billing address is provided, it will be considered the same as the shipping address.

Field Type Description
address1 string First line of the address.
address2 string Second line of the address (optional).
city string City of the address.
state string State or province.
state_code string State abbreviation.
country string Country name.
country_code string ISO country code (e.g., US, SA).
zip string ZIP or postal code.
latitude number Geographical latitude.
longitude number Geographical longitude.
first_name string First name of the person.
last_name string Last name of the person.
phone string Contact phone number.
country_calling_code string Country calling code (e.g., +966, +90).

🧾 Invoice (orders.invoice)

This object contains the billing and payment details related to the order.

Field Type Description
currency string Currency code (e.g., USD, SAR).
subtotal number Total before taxes & discounts.
shipping_price number Cost of shipping.
shipping_refund number Refund amount for shipping (if applicable).
tax number Tax amount calculated based on tax percentage.
discount number Total discount applied to the order.
total number Final amount after taxes & discounts.
total_paid number Amount already paid.
total_due number Remaining amount to be paid.
total_refunded number Total refunded amount.
payment_mode string Payment method (e.g., Mada, Credit Card).
payment_method string Payment state (prepaid, postpaid, pending).
is_cash_on_delivery boolean Indicates if cash on delivery is used.
tax_percent number Tax percentage applied.
shipping_tax number Tax on shipping cost.
sub_total_tax_inclusive boolean Indicates if the subtotal includes tax.
sub_total_discount_inclusive boolean Indicates if the subtotal includes discounts.
shipping_tax_inclusive boolean Indicates if the shipping cost includes tax.
shipping_discount_inclusive boolean Indicates if the shipping cost includes discounts.
attachments array List of associated attachment files.
attachments[].url string URL of the attachment (e.g., https://example.com/avatar1.jpg).
attachments[].type string Type of the attachment (e.g., image1, image2, image3).

👤 Customer (orders.customer)

Stores the customer details associated with the order. The system auto-fetches these details if a customer ID is provided. If not, you can manually enter the details.

Field Type Description
id string Customer ID (auto-fetches details if provided).
first_name string Customer's first name.
last_name string Customer's last name.
mobile string Mobile number.
mobile_code string Country code for mobile.
email string Email address.
gender string Gender (male, female, other).
country string Country of the customer.
country_code string Country code of the customer.
country_calling_code string Country's international calling code (e.g., +966, +90).
avatar string URL of the customer's profile picture.

🚚 Shipment Type (orders.shipment_type)

Defines the type of shipment for the order.

Type Description
omniful_generated Omniful Generated Shipment: Shipments created manually or automatically by Omniful.
sales_channel_generated Sales Channel Generated Shipment: Shipments generated by the sales channel system.

🚛 Delivery Type (orders.delivery_type)

Specifies the delivery method for an order.

Type Description
click_and_collect The order will be prepared for collection by the customer at a designated location.
express_delivery The order will be delivered to the customer on an expedited basis.
slot_delivery The order will be delivered within a specific time slot chosen by the customer.
normal_delivery The order will be delivered using the standard delivery method.

💳 Transaction Details (orders.transactions)

An array of transaction objects, each representing a single transaction.

Field Type Description
transaction_id string A unique identifier for the transaction (e.g., "T123456").
amount number The monetary value of the transaction (e.g., 100.50).
type integer Type of transaction (1: Coupon, 2: Coin, 3: Gift Card, 4: Account).
card_number string The masked card number used for the transaction (e.g., "411111**1111").
source_account string The account from which the transaction originates.
destination_account string The account receiving the transaction.
status integer Current state of the transaction (1: Pending, 2: Completed, 3: Failed).
description string A brief note about the transaction (e.g., "Payment for order #12345").

🌍 External Fields (order.external_fields)

Allows adding custom order data as key-value pairs.

Field Type Description
key string External field name.
value string External field value.

⏳ Order Auto-Cancellation (order.cancel_order_after_seconds)

Defines the time (in seconds) after which the order will automatically cancel if it is in the on_hold state.

Field Type Description
cancel_order_after_seconds int Time (in seconds) after which the order will be automatically canceled if it's on hold.

request.description:
📌 Create Shipment API – Overview

The Create Shipment API is used to generate shipments for orders in Omniful.

This API allows users to:

  • Assign a shipping partner

  • Generate tracking numbers (AWB)

  • Set shipment details

Note: The API only supports orders with the shipment type set to Omniful Generated.

Orders with other shipment types are not eligible for shipment creation through this API.

Request Body Parameters

Field Data Type Description Required
number_of_boxes number Total number of packages to be shipped ✅ Yes
weight number Total weight of all packages (in kilograms) ❌ No
remarks string Additional notes for shipment handling ❌ No

Response Body Parameters

Field Data Type Description Always Included
is_success boolean Indicates whether the request was successful ✅ Yes
status_code number Response status code ✅ Yes
data object Contains shipment information ✅ Yes
data.oms_order_id string Omniful system order ID ✅ Yes
data.status string Current shipment status ✅ Yes
data.shipping_partner_order_id string Order ID assigned by shipping partner ✅ Yes
data.awb_number string Air waybill number for tracking ✅ Yes
data.shipping_partner_status string Shipment status from the shipping partner ✅ Yes
data.shipping_partner_tag string Unique tag of the shipping partner ✅ Yes
data.shipping_partner_name string Name of the shipping partner ✅ Yes
data.tracking_url string URL to track the shipment ✅ Yes
data.awb_label string URL to download the shipping label ✅ Yes
data.number_of_boxes number Number of packages in the shipment ✅ Yes
data.weight number Total shipment weight (in kilograms) ✅ Yes
data.remarks string Shipment handling notes ❌ No
data.pickup_otp string One-time password for pickup ❌ No
data.shipping_reference string Reference number for the shipment ❌ No
data.print_awb_allowed boolean Indicates if AWB can be printed ✅ Yes
data.print_manual_awb_allowed boolean Indicates if manual AWB can be printed ✅ Yes
data.print_delivery_note_allowed boolean Indicates if a delivery note can be printed ✅ Yes
data.shipping_account.id number Shipping account identifier ✅ Yes
data.shipping_account.name string Name of the shipping account ✅ Yes
data.shipping_account.display_name string Display name of the shipping account ✅ Yes
data.courier_partner.id number Courier service identifier ✅ Yes
data.courier_partner.name string Name of the courier service ✅ Yes
data.courier_partner.tag string Unique tag of the courier service ✅ Yes
data.courier_partner.logo string URL to the courier service logo ✅ Yes

✅ Improvements made:

  • Cleaned up phrasing (“Permission to print” → “Indicates if … can be printed”).

  • Standardized weight references to kilograms.

  • Clarified “links” as URL for tracking/labels/logos.

  • Added callout for Omniful Generated constraint.

  • Made deprecation notice visually prominent.

Do you want me to also prepare a sample request/response JSON payload (with dummy values) for this API, like we did for Get Order Logs, so developers can see exactly how the structure looks in practice?

request.description:
📌 Add Shipment Details API – Overview

The Add Shipment Details API allows users to add existing shipment details for an order.

This API is typically used to update shipment-related information such as:

  • Tracking numbers (AWB)

  • Courier service details

  • Delivery tracking URLs

📌 Key Information

  • This API applies only to orders where the shipment type is either:

    • sales_channel_generated

    • sales_channel_notified

  • If the shipment was created by the sales channel, users can update the shipment details as required.

  • Always confirm the shipment type before making updates.

  • Please use the Get Courier Partners API to retrieve the correct courier partner tag. If the provided tag is invalid, it will automatically default to manual

Request Body Parameters

Field Data Type Description Required
tracking_url string URL to the carrier’s tracking page for real-time status updates ❌ No
awb_number string Unique airway bill (AWB) number provided by the carrier ✅ Yes
awb_label string Shipping label content, including barcodes and package identification details ❌ No
package_details object Information about package quantity, weight, size, and handling notes ❌ No
package_details.number_of_boxes number Total number of boxes in the shipment (positive integer) ❌ No
package_details.weight number Overall shipment weight in kilograms (kg) ❌ No
package_details.dimensions object Physical dimensions of the package (length, breadth, height) ❌ No
package_details.dimensions.length number Length in centimeters (cm), measured along the longest side ❌ No
package_details.dimensions.breadth number Breadth/width in centimeters (cm) ❌ No
package_details.dimensions.height number Height in centimeters (cm) ❌ No
package_details.remarks string Special handling notes (e.g., "Fragile", "Handle with care") ❌ No
courier_partner object Information about the courier partner handling last-mile delivery ✅ Yes
courier_partner.tag string Short code/tag representing the courier partner ✅ Yes

request.description:
📌 Update Shipment Status API - Overview

The Update Shipment Status API allows users to update the shipment status of an order, ensuring real-time tracking updates for better shipment visibility.

📌 Supported Shipment Types:

  • Manual Shipment (omniful_generated) – Shipments created manually by users.

  • Sales Channel Generated Shipment (sales_channel_generated) – Shipments generated by the sales channel system.

  • Sales Channel Notified Shipment (sales_channel_notified) – Shipments updated based on notifications from the sales channel.

This API helps keep users informed about their order's shipping progress by providing regular updates on courier tracking.

The following shipment statuses can be used to update the shipment status of an order:

Status Description
dispatched Shipment has been handed over to the carrier and is en route.
out_for_delivery Shipment is on its way to the final destination for delivery.
in_transit Shipment is moving between different locations or hubs.
delivered Shipment has been successfully delivered to the recipient.
return_to_origin Shipment is being returned to the origin due to failed delivery or other reasons.

📌 Create Master SKU API – Overview

The Create Master SKU API allows users to create a new SKU in the Master Catalogue.

This API is used to add products to the seller’s catalog with essential details such as SKU code, pricing, attributes, and classification.

✅ Required Fields for Creating a Master SKU

  • sku_code → Unique identifier for the SKU (e.g., "SKU-TV-123")

  • type → SKU type ("simple" or "bundle")

  • status → SKU lifecycle status (must be one of: all, live, ready_to_list, under_review, draft, un_sync, others)

  • currency → 3 letter ISO 4217 code eg. SAR, AED, INR, USD etc.

⚠️ Important Considerations

  • Unique SKU Code → Each SKU must have a unique sku_code.

  • Pricing → Must specify cost, selling_price, and retail_price.

  • Handling Type → Must be "hot" or "cold" (storage/handling conditions).

  • SKU Type → "simple" for standalone products, "bundle" for grouped products.

  • Status Lifecycle → Valid options: all, live, ready_to_list, under_review, draft, un_sync, others.

Request Body Parameters

Field Data Type Description Required
name string Product name, e.g., "Smart LED TV" ✅ Yes
description string Detailed description, e.g., "High-quality 4K Smart LED TV with Wi-Fi connectivity" ✅ Yes

request.description:
Endpoint Description

This endpoint allows the user to create a shipment for a specific return order identified by :id. It is used to update the shipment details associated with a return order, including tracking information and package specifications.

Request Body

The request body must be in JSON format and should include the following parameters:

  • tracking_url (string): A URL that provides tracking information for the shipment.

  • awb_number (string): The Air Waybill number associated with the shipment.

  • package_details (object): An object containing details about the package.

    • number_of_boxes (integer): The number of boxes being shipped.

    • weight (integer): The weight of the package in appropriate units.

    • dimensions (object): An object specifying the dimensions of the package.

      • length (integer): The length of the package.

      • breadth (integer): The breadth of the package.

      • height (integer): The height of the package.

    • remarks (string): Any special handling instructions for the package.

  • courier_partner (object): An object specifying the courier partner.

    • tag (string): The identifier for the courier partner.

Response

The response will be in JSON format and will contain the following fields:

  • is_success (boolean): Indicates whether the shipment creation was successful.

  • status_code (integer): A code representing the status of the request.

  • data (string): Additional data related to the shipment, if any.

This endpoint is crucial for managing the logistics of return orders by allowing users to specify shipment details and track their packages effectively.

response.name: Success

request.description:
Update Shipment Status for Return Orders

This endpoint allows you to update the shipment status of a specific return order identified by its unique id. It is particularly useful for managing the logistics of returned items, enabling the system to track the status of shipments effectively.

Request Body

The request body must be in JSON format and should include the following parameter:

  • shipment_status (string): The new status of the shipment. Following are the allowed values:

    • "picked_up"

    • "return_to_origin"

The sequence of shipment statuses is created -> picked_up -> return_to_origin.

Response

The response from this endpoint will be in JSON format and will contain the following fields:

  • is_success (boolean): Indicates whether the operation was successful.

  • status_code (integer): A code representing the status of the request (200 typically indicates success).

  • data (object or null): Contains additional data related to the request, if applicable.

This structure ensures that users can easily understand the outcome of their request and take appropriate actions based on the response received.

📌 Create Return Request API – Overview

The Create Return Request API is used to initiate a return request for orders that are in the delivered state.

This API ensures efficient tracking and management of returned items by capturing essential details such as order ID, reasons for return, and hub information.

📌 Key Points to Consider

  • The order must be in the delivered state before a return request can be created.

  • Each return request must include:

    • order_id

    • return_reason

    • hub_code (if applicable)

    • order_items with SKU details and return quantities

✅ Required Fields

  • order_id (string) → Unique identifier for the order.

  • return_reason (string) → Overall reason for initiating the return.

  • hub_code (string) → Hub associated with the order.

  • order_items (array) → List of returned items, including:

    • sku_code (string) → SKU identifier of the item.

    • return_quantity (number) → Quantity of the item being returned.

    • return_reasons (array) → Specific reasons and quantities for return.

  • return_request_id (string) → Unique identifier for the return request.

📌 Request Body Parameters

Field Data Type Description Required
order_id string Unique identifier for the order associated with the return request ✅ Yes
return_reason string Overall return reason (e.g., "Damaged and Wrong Item") ✅ Yes
hub_code string Hub code where the return request is processed ❌ No
order_items array List of returned items with details ✅ Yes
order_items[].sku_code string SKU code of the returned product ✅ Yes
order_items[].return_quantity integer Total quantity of the SKU being returned ✅ Yes
order_items[].return_reasons array Specific reasons and corresponding quantities ❌ No
order_items[].return_reasons[].reason string Return reason (e.g., "Damaged", "Wrong Item") ❌ No
order_items[].return_reasons[].quantity integer Quantity associated with the return reason ❌ No
return_request_id string Unique identifier for the return request (used for tracking) ✅ Yes

📌 Get Return Request API - Overview

The Get Return Request API allows users to retrieve return requests for orders based on request status, order ID, and return order ID.

📌 Filters Available:

  • order_id – Fetch return requests for a specific order.

  • return_order_id – Retrieve details of a specific return request.

  • status – Filter return requests by status.

  • created_from - Filter return request by date of creation

By default, return requests will be returned for the last 3 months only. The supported date formats are yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss and yyyy-mm-dd.

📌 Return Request Statuses:

  • new – The return request has been submitted and is awaiting action.

  • approved – The return request has been approved for processing.

  • rejected – The return request has been declined.

This API helps users track return requests efficiently, ensuring seamless return management.

request.description:
📌 Approve Return Request API - Overview

The Approve Return Request API is used to approve return requests for an order based on its return order ID. This API allows users to approve full or partial returns and process refunds accordingly.

📌 Important Fields:

Field Type Description
order_id string Unique identifier for the order.
order_items array of objects List of items being approved for return.
order_items.sku_code string SKU code of the item being returned.
order_items.return_quantity number Quantity of the SKU to be returned.
order_items.return_reason string Reason for the return.
total_refundable_amount number Total amount to be refunded for the return order.
approval_mode string Mode of approval: "full" or "partial".
return_request_id string Unique identifier of the return request.

📌 Approval Modes:

  • Full Approval: Approves all order items in the return request. If full approval is selected, the "order_items" field can be empty, as all items in the request will be approved.
  • Partial Approval: Approves only specific order items. If partial approval is selected, users must explicitly specify the order items to be approved.

This API ensures smooth return processing, allowing businesses to handle refunds and return approvals efficiently.

item.description:
Sales Channel Returns — API Folder Overview

Use these APIs when creating and managing return requests and return orders for purchases placed on a seller’s Custom API integrated Sales Channels. This folder covers the full workflow from raising a return request against a channel order, through approval/rejection, to creating the resulting return order in Omniful.

When to use this folder

  • The original order was created from a Custom API Sales Channel into Omniful and then Delivered.

  • You need to create/approve/reject return requests and, if approved, return orders tied to the channel order and its line items.

  • For returns of orders created directly by any other seller sales channel, use the Seller Returns folder.

  • For returns of only the Custom API Sales Channel orders, use the Sales Channel Returns folder.

item.description:
📌 Return Order API Collection - Overview

The Return Order API Collection provides a set of APIs to manage return orders efficiently.

📌 Key Functions:

  • Create Return Order Request – Initiate a return request for an order.

  • Approve Return Order Request – Approve a return request for processing.

  • Create Return Order – Create a return order.

  • Reject Return Order Request – Decline a return request if it doesn't meet the return criteria.

These APIs help streamline the returns process, ensuring smooth handling of customer returns and order reversals.

item.name: Purchase Order

request.description:
📌 Create Purchase Order API – Overview

The Create Purchase Order API allows users to generate new purchase orders for suppliers, enabling streamlined procurement and inventory management.

📌 Key Points to Consider

  • To route the purchase order to a specific hub, provide the hub_code in the path parameter.

  • A purchase order must include at least one valid SKU in purchase_order_items.

  • Currency must be defined using a 3-letter ISO code (e.g., SAR for Saudi Riyal, USD for US Dollar).

✅ Required Fields

  • supplier_code – Unique identifier for the supplier.

  • purchase_order_items – Must contain at least one item with:

    • sku_code

    • quantity

  • currency – Currency code for the purchase order.

📌 Request Body Parameters

Field Data Type Description Required
supplier_email string Supplier’s email address ❌ No
supplier_code string Unique identifier code for the supplier ✅ Yes
over_receive_allowed boolean Whether receiving more than the ordered quantity is permitted (true / false) ❌ No
purchase_order_items array List of items included in the purchase order ✅ Yes
purchase_order_items[].sku_code string SKU code of the product ✅ Yes
purchase_order_items[].quantity integer Quantity of the product to purchase ✅ Yes
purchase_order_items[].unit_price float Price per unit of the product ❌ No
remark string Additional notes or comments about the purchase order ❌ No
reference_purchase_order_id string External reference ID for the purchase order ❌ No
currency string ISO 4217 3-letter currency code (e.g., "SAR", "USD") ✅ Yes

📌 Get Purchase Order API - Overview

The Get Purchase Order API allows users to retrieve all purchase orders for a specific hub using various query filters.

📌 Filters Available:

  • Purchase Order Number – Retrieve details of a specific purchase order.

This API helps users track, manage, and analyze purchase orders efficiently within the hub.

request.description:
📌 Get Single Purchase Order API - Overview

The Get Single Purchase Order API retrieves the details of a specific purchase order using its purchase order ID for the provided hub ID.

This API helps users access complete purchase order information.

Field Name Type Description
purchase_order_id String The unique ID for this purchase order.
order_details.quantity Integer The total number of items ordered in this purchase order.
order_details.grn_pass_quantity Integer The number of items that passed inspection during the goods receipt process.
order_details.grn_fail_quantity Integer The number of items that failed inspection during the goods receipt process.
order_details.put_away_pass_quantity Integer The number of items that were successfully stored in inventory.
order_details.put_away_fail_quantity Integer The number of items that could not be stored in inventory.
seller.name String The name of the seller who provided the order.
seller.phone String The seller's contact phone number.
seller.email String The seller's email address.
hub_code String The code for the hub where the order is processed.
supplier.name String The name of the supplier providing the items.
supplier.phone String The supplier's contact phone number.
supplier.email String The supplier's email address.
status String The current status of the purchase order (e.g., "ordered").
total_amount Number The total cost of the purchase order.
currency String The three-letter currency code used (e.g., SAR for Saudi Riyal).
item_number Integer The number of unique items included in the purchase order.
remark String Any extra notes or comments about the purchase order.
purchase_order_items.id Integer A unique ID for each individual item in the purchase order.
purchase_order_items.tenant_id String The identifier for the tenant associated with this purchase order.
purchase_order_items.seller_id String The identifier for the seller related to this specific item.
purchase_order_items.hub_id Integer The hub ID where this item is processed.
purchase_order_items.purchase_order_id Integer The purchase order ID to which this item belongs.
purchase_order_items.sku.name String The name of the SKU (product) for this item.
purchase_order_items.sku.seller_sku_id String The seller's unique identifier for this SKU.
purchase_order_items.sku.seller_sku_code String The seller's SKU code for this item.
purchase_order_items.sku.images Array A list of image URLs for the SKU.
purchase_order_items.sku.attributes Array A list of attributes (e.g., color, size) that describe the SKU.
purchase_order_items.sku.package_type String The type of packaging used for the SKU (e.g., box, envelope).
purchase_order_items.quantity Integer The number of units ordered for this item.
purchase_order_items.unit_price Number The price per unit of the item.
purchase_order_items.child_purchase_order_items Array Any sub-items related to this purchase order item, if applicable.
purchase_order_items.updated_at String The timestamp (in ISO format) of the last update for this item.
purchase_order_items.opened_quantity Integer The number of units that have been opened or unpacked.
purchase_order_items.received_quantity Integer The number of units that have been received for this item.
grn_details Array Details from the goods receipt notes related to this purchase order.
expected_receiving_date Array The expected dates for receiving the goods.
created_at String The date and time when the purchase order was created (in ISO format).
created_by String The name of the user who created the purchase order.
meta.current_page Integer The current page number in the paginated results.
meta.last_page Integer The last available page number in the paginated results.
meta.per_page Integer The number of items displayed per page.
meta.total Integer The total number of items across all pages.

item.description:
📌 Purchase Order API Collection - Overview

The Purchase Order API Collection on Postman provides a set of APIs that allow users to efficiently manage purchase orders and suppliers.

📌 Key Features:

  • Create Purchase Orders – Generate new purchase orders for suppliers.

  • View Purchase Orders – Retrieve details of existing purchase orders.

  • Update Purchase Orders – Modify purchase order details before processing.

  • Manage Suppliers – View and create supplier records for procurement.

This collection helps businesses streamline procurement operations, ensuring smooth supplier management and inventory replenishment.

request.description:
Query Params

should_not_adjust_inventory (string): Set to true if you do not want to adjust inventory; otherwise, the inventory will always be adjusted.

Example: {{base_url}}/sales-channel/public/v1/pos/order?should_not_adjust_inventory=true

Order Details

order_id (String)

Unique identifier for the order.

order_alias (String)

Alias or alternate identifier for the order.

customer (Object)

Details of the customer placing the order.

  • first_name (String): First name of the customer.

  • last_name (String): Last name of the customer.

  • email (String): Email address of the customer.

  • mobile (String): Mobile number of the customer.

  • mobile_code (String): Country code for the mobile number.

  • country_code (String): Country code of the customer.

hub_code (String)

Code identifying the hub related to the order.

order_created_at (String)

Timestamp indicating when the order was created.

order_items (Array)

List of items in the order.

  • sales_channel_sku_id (String): SKU ID from the sales channel.

  • seller_sku_code (String): Seller's SKU code.

  • sales_channel_order_item_id (String): Order item ID from the sales channel.

  • display_price (Float): Displayed price of the item.

  • selling_price (Float): Selling price of the item.

  • quantity (Int): Quantity of the item in the order.

  • tax_percent (Float): Tax percentage applicable to the item.

  • tax (Float): Tax amount for the item.

  • unit_price (Float): Unit price of the item.

  • total (Float): Total price for the quantity of the item.

  • subtotal (Float): Subtotal price for the item.

  • tax_inclusive (Boolean): Indicates if tax is included in the price.

  • discount (Float): Discount applied to the item.

invoice (Object)

Details of the invoice for the order.

  • currency (String): Currency used for the invoice.

  • subtotal (Float): Subtotal amount of the invoice.

  • shipping_tax (Float): Tax applied to shipping.

  • sub_total_tax_inclusive (Boolean): Indicates if subtotal includes tax.

  • sub_total_discount_inclusive (Boolean): Indicates if subtotal includes discount.

  • shipping_tax_inclusive (Boolean): Indicates if shipping tax is inclusive.

  • shipping_discount_inclusive (Boolean): Indicates if shipping discount is inclusive.

  • shipping_price (Float): Price for shipping.

  • shipping_refund (Float): Refund amount for shipping.

  • tax (Float): Total tax amount.

  • tax_percent (Float): Total tax percentage.

  • discount (Float): Total discount applied.

  • total (Float): Total amount payable.

  • total_paid (Float): Total amount paid.

  • total_due (Float): Total amount due.

  • total_refunded (Float): Total amount refunded.

  • payment_mode (String): Mode of payment(such as ApplePay etc).

  • loyalty_discount (Number): Discount applied through loyalty program.

⚠️ Important Notice:

The "meta_data" field will be deprecated from the response of this API, effective February 15, 2025. Please update your integrations to accommodate this change and ensure a smooth transition.

📌 Return-to-Sender Order API - Overview

The Return-to-Sender Order API is used to create return orders for SKUs that need to be sent back due to expiration, quality check failures, or incorrect items received in a purchase order.

📌 Return Type Guidelines:

  • Supplier Returns: Set the type to "supplier" and provide the supplier code.

  • Seller Returns: Set the type to "seller" and provide the seller code.

  • Other Returns: Set the type to "other" (no code required).

📌 Additional Requirements for "Other" Returns:

  • Shipping details must be provided.

  • Billing details are mandatory.

  • Custom details must be included.

This API ensures efficient handling of returns, helping businesses manage inventory discrepancies and streamline return processing.

Field Name Type Description Required
order_id String A unique ID for the return order. ✓ Yes
hub_code String The code for the hub that handles this return. ✓ Yes
recipient_details.type String Specifies the type of recipient (for example, "supplier"). ✓ Yes
recipient_details.code String A unique code that identifies the recipient. ✓ Yes
order_items.sku_code String The SKU code for the product being returned. ✓ Yes
order_items.name String The name of the product. ✓ Yes
order_items.display_price Number The original or list price of the product. ✓ Yes
order_items.selling_price Number The actual selling price of the product. ✓ Yes
order_items.is_substituted Boolean True if the product was substituted; otherwise, false. ✓ Yes
order_items.quantity Integer The number of units being returned. ✓ Yes
order_items.tax_percent Number The tax percentage applied to the product. ✓ Yes
order_items.tax Number The tax amount for the product. ✓ Yes
order_items.unit_price Number The cost per unit of the product. ✓ Yes
order_items.subtotal Number The subtotal for this item before tax is added. ✓ Yes
order_items.total Number The total cost for this item, including tax. ✓ Yes
order_items.discount Number The discount applied to this item. ✓ Yes
order_items.tax_inclusive Boolean True if the listed price already includes tax; otherwise, false. ✓ Yes
billing_address.address1 String The first line of the billing address. ✓ Yes
billing_address.city String The city for the billing address. ✓ Yes
billing_address.country String The country for the billing address. ✓ Yes
billing_address.first_name String The first name of the billing contact. ✓ Yes
billing_address.last_name String The last name of the billing contact. ✓ Yes
billing_address.phone String The phone number for billing. ✓ Yes
billing_address.state String The state for the billing address. ✓ Yes
billing_address.zip String The ZIP or postal code for the billing address. ✓ Yes
billing_address.state_code String The state code for the billing address. ✓ Yes
billing_address.country_code String The country code for the billing address. ✓ Yes
billing_address.latitude Number The latitude coordinate of the billing address. ✓ Yes
billing_address.longitude Number The longitude coordinate of the billing address. ✓ Yes
billing_address.national_address_code String The national address code of the billing address. X No
shipping_address.address1 String The first line of the shipping address. ✓ Yes
shipping_address.city String The city for the shipping address. ✓ Yes

item.description:
📌 Return-to-Sender Order API - Overview

The Return-to-Sender Order API allows users to create a return order for SKUs that need to be sent back to the supplier.

📌 Common Use Cases:

  • Returning expired items.

  • Sending back items that failed quality checks (QC).

  • Returning incorrect SKUs received in a purchase order.

This API helps ensure efficient inventory management and accurate supplier returns.

request.description:
Required Fields for Creating Stock Transfer Requests:

  1. transfer_id (string): The unique identifier for the stock transfer (must be unique always).

  2. order_items (array of objects): An array of objects representing the items in the stock transfer.

    • sku_code (string): The stock keeping unit code for the item.

    • quantity (integer): The quantity of the item being transferred.

  3. source_hub_code (string): The hub code from which the stock is being transferred.

  4. destination_hub_code (string): The hub code to which the stock is being transferred.

  5. sto_id (string): The unique identifier for the sales channel.

  6. customer: Customer details associated with the transfer.

response.name: Create Stock Transfer Request

request.description:
Required Fields for Updating Stock Transfer Requests:

  1. action_type (string): Specifies the action to perform.

    • "add_items": To add new items to the stock transfer request.

    • "edit_items": To edit existing items in the stock transfer request.

  2. order_items (array of objects): An array of objects representing the items in the stock transfer.

    • sku_code (string): The stock keeping unit code for the item.

    • quantity (integer): The quantity of the item to be added or updated.

response.name: Update Stock Transfer Request

request.description:
Required Fields for Approving Stock Transfer Requests:

  1. order_items (array of objects): An array of objects representing the items being approved in the stock transfer.

    • sku_code (string): The stock keeping unit code for the item.

    • quantity (integer): The quantity of the item being approved.

Get Stock Transfer Orders API Documentation

Overview

This API endpoint retrieves detailed information about stock transfer orders and requires a valid destination hub code—the hub specified in the stock transfer request where receiving will occur—which must be powered through the Omniful system. You can also use filters to narrow down the results. The available filters are:

  • sto_request_id: Filter by a single stock transfer request ID.

  • sto_request_ids: Filter by multiple stock transfer request IDs.

  • sto_number: Filter by a single stock transfer order number.

  • sto_numbers: Filter by multiple stock transfer order numbers.

item.description:
📌 Webhook Payload Reference

Overview

This section provides sample webhook payloads for all available webhooks. You can refer to these payloads to understand the structure and expected data for each event.

🔹 How to Use

  • Review the sample webhook payloads to understand the data format.

  • Use them as a reference when setting up webhook listeners in your system.

  • Ensure your application can handle incoming webhook requests and parse the payload accordingly.

For detailed webhook event descriptions and payload samples, refer to the following Documentation. 🚀

🔐 Custom Headers

Custom HTTP headers can be added to webhook events to support advanced use cases such as authentication, request routing, or internal tracking.

✨ Key Capabilities

  • Add up to 2 custom headers per webhook event

  • Each header consists of a key–value pair

  • These headers are sent with every webhook request for the configured event

📏 Constraints

Attribute Limit
Maximum custom headers 2
Header key max length 50 characters
Header value max length 4500 characters

🚫 Restricted Header Keys

For security and system integrity reasons, custom header keys must NOT use any of the following reserved headers:

x-omniful-request-id
x-omniful-channel-name
webhook-secret-key
webhook-event
tracestate
traceparent
newrelic

📘 Status Code Reference (order_status)

✅ Order Status Codes

Status Label Status Code
On Hold on_hold
Hub Assigned hub_assigned
New Order new_order
Picked picked
Packed packed
Ready To Ship ready_to_ship
Shipped shipped
Delivered delivered
Cancelled cancelled

🔁 Return Status Codes

Status Label Status Code
New Return Request new_return_request
Return Request Approved return_request_approved
Return Request Rejected return_request_rejected
Return Order Initiated return_initiated
Return Shipment Created return_shipment_created
Return Order Arrived At Hub return_order_arrived_at_hub
Return Order QC Processed return_order_qc_processed
Return Order Picked Up return_order_picked_up
Return Order Cancelled return_order_cancelled
Return Order Completed return_order_completed
Return To Origin return_to_origin

response.name: Get Webhooks

request.description:
Description: This endpoint allows clients to add or update webhook configurations for various topics. Each topic corresponds to a specific webhook type defined in the system.

Request Body:

The request body should be a JSON object containing the following fields:

  • topic: A string representing the webhook topic. This must match one of the predefined webhook types.

  • webhook_url: A string containing the URL where the webhook notifications should be sent.

  • is_enable: A boolean indicating whether the webhook is enabled or not.

Valid Topics:

  • order_webhook

  • product_webhook

  • inventory_webhook

  • delivery_zone_webhook

  • purchase_order_webhook

  • shipment_order_webhook

  • stock_transfer_request_webhook

  • inwarding_webhook
