Field Data Type Description
integration_id String Unique identifier for the store integration.
tag String Type of integration (e.g., shopify, custom).
store_entity String Store-specific identifier on the platform (if any).
name String Store name given by the seller.
is_active Boolean Indicates if the store integration is currently active.
created_at String Timestamp when the store integration was created.

current_page Integer Current page in pagination.
per_page Integer Number of records per page.
last_page Integer Last page number.
total Integer Total number of integrated stores.

request.description:
This API allows you to obtain a new access token and refresh token using a refresh token grant type. Access tokens are short-lived tokens that grant access to specific resources or actions within an API, while refresh tokens are used to request new access tokens without requiring the user to re-authenticate.

Upon sending this request to the Omniful API, you will receive a response containing the new access token and refresh token, which you can then use to access protected resources and perform authorized actions on behalf of the authenticated user.

item.description:
The SKUs folder contains all APIs related to managing product SKUs for a seller.

These APIs allow partners and developers to create, retrieve, update, and manage SKUs in the seller’s Master Catalog.

SKUs are a core part of Omniful’s catalog management system, enabling sellers to define SKU details, pricing, dimensions, images, and attributes in a structured, channel-ready format.

📌 Overview

SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) represent items that sellers fulfil and ship through Omniful.

The APIs in this folder help you:

  • Create new SKUs under a seller

  • List SKUs belonging to a seller

  • Retrieve detailed information for a single SKU

  • Update existing SKUs (pricing, status, barcodes, attributes, etc.)

📌 Key Concepts

SKU Code

A unique identifier for each SKU (e.g., "SKU-TV-123").

This must be unique at the seller level.

SKU Types

  • simple – standalone products

  • bundle (kits) – grouped or packaged products

SKU Status Values

Represents the SKU’s workflow stage:

  • active

  • inactive

📋 Common Fields Across SKU APIs

The following table provides a detailed explanation of key fields used across all SKU-related APIs in the Omniful Sales Channel ecosystem.

Field Type Description
id integer Unique identifier assigned to the SKU in Omniful.
sku_code string Unique SKU code used to identify the product at the seller level.
seller_code string Code of the seller to whom the SKU belongs.
name string Display name/title of the SKU.
description string Detailed description of the SKU.
type string SKU type — simple or bundle. Determines product structure.
status string Current SKU status (active,inactive).
brand string Brand associated with the SKU.
country_of_origin string Country where the SKU was manufactured or sourced.
barcodes array[string] List of barcodes associated with the SKU. Multiple barcodes are supported.
images array[object] List of product images. Can include a default image URL.
weight.value number Weight of the product.
weight.uom string Unit of measurement for weight (e.g., kg, g, lb, ea).
uom string Default UOM used for selling or inventory (e.g., ea).
dimensions.length.length number Length of the SKU.
dimensions.length.unit string Unit for length (e.g., cm, in).
dimensions.breadth.breadth number Breadth/width of the SKU.
dimensions.breadth.unit string Unit for breadth.
dimensions.height.height number Height of the SKU.
dimensions.height.unit string Unit for height.
currency string Currency code used for SKU prices (e.g., SAR, AED).
retail_price number Maximum Retail Price (MRP) of the SKU.
selling_price number Actual selling price used in transactions.
cost_price number Cost price of the item (if applicable).
is_perishable boolean Indicates whether the SKU has a perishable nature.
handling_type string Handling requirements such as hot or cold (if required by marketplace).
created_at string Timestamp when the SKU record was created.
updated_at string Timestamp indicating the last update to the SKU.
created_by string User/system who created the SKU.
updated_by string User/system who last updated the SKU.

Description

Updates an existing tenant hub’s details and configuration.

Use this endpoint when you need to change a hub’s address, services (e.g., WMS/POS), working hours, or operational configurations (picking, packing, cycle count, etc.).

The endpoint performs a partial update: most fields are optional, but when an object is provided (like address, configuration.picking, etc.), the required fields inside that object must be present.

📌 Key things to know:

  • hub_code (in path) identifies which hub to update.

  • Body fields are optional, but object-level groups are all-or-nothing:

    • If address is sent → all its required subfields must be present.

    • If configuration.picking is sent → its subfields must satisfy validation, etc.

📌 Additional Mandatory Fields for Saudi Arabia (KSA)
If the country is Saudi Arabia (KSA), the following address fields are mandatory:

  • national_address_code

  • additional_number

  • building_number

  • area

  • street

Note
These fields are required to comply with Saudi National Address regulations, and requests will fail validation if they are missing when the country is set to KSA.

Parameters

Path Parameters

Name Type Required Example Description
hub_code string True "Dark_store_1" Hub code identifier to update

Body Parameters

Body is a single Hub object.

All fields below are optional, unless otherwise specified.

However, if an object is provided (e.g. address, configuration.picking), all required fields inside that object must be present.

Top-Level Fields

Name Type Required Example Notes
type string False "dark_store" Hub type (e.g., "warehouse", "dark_store")

working_hours object False {...} If a day is provided, its start_time and end_time are required

Only fields included within each hub mapping object will be updated.
Fields not included will remain unchanged.

item.description:
The Hubs folder contains all APIs related to managing operational locations (hubs) for a tenant – such as warehouses, dark stores, and retail stores.

These APIs allow partners and developers to create hubs, list existing hubs, retrieve detailed hub configurations, and bulk update hub status in a consistent, tenant-wide way.

Hubs are a core part of Omniful’s fulfillment network, acting as the physical locations from which inventory is stored, picked, packed, and shipped.

📌 Overview

Hubs represent the locations where operations happen in Omniful (storage, picking, packing, handover, POS, etc.).

The APIs in this folder help you:

  • Create new hubs for a tenant (with address, working hours, and configuration).

  • List hubs belonging to a tenant with filters and pagination.

  • Retrieve detailed configuration for a specific hub via hub_code.

  • Bulk update hub status (e.g., activate/deactivate multiple hubs).

Typical use cases:

  • Onboarding a new warehouse / dark store network.

  • Building hub selector components in internal tools.

  • Enabling/disabling hubs in bulk during rollouts or maintenance.

Description

Retrieve a paginated list of orders for a specific seller.

You can filter results using multiple optional query parameters such as order ID, customer details, AWB number, SKU code, status, types, and date range.

Path Parameters

Name Type Required Description
seller_code string Yes Unique seller identifier in Omniful.

Query Parameters

Name Type Required Description
page integer No Page number for pagination (default: 1).
per_page integer No Number of records per page (default: 20).
order_id string No Filter by order ID.
customer_name string No Filter by customer name.
customer_email string No Filter by customer email.
status string No Filter by order status (e.g., delivered).
types string No Filter by order type (e.g., b2b).
customer_id string No Filter by customer ID.
awb_number string No Filter by AWB number.
order_alias string No Filter by order alias.
omniful_order_id string No Filter by internal Omniful order ID.
customer_phone_number string No Filter by phone number.
sku_code string No Filter by SKU code in order items.
created_from date (YYYY-MM-DD) No Filter from order creation date.
created_to date (YYYY-MM-DD) No Filter until order creation date.

Notes

  • All filters are optional.

  • Pagination defaults to page=1 and per_page=20 if not provided.

  • Empty query values (e.g., customer_id=) are ignored.

  • Combining multiple filters narrows the results further.

request.description:
📌 Create Order API Overview

The Create Order API allows users to place new orders in Omniful by providing order details, customer information, shipping and billing addresses, invoice details, and payment information.

📝 Request Body Parameters

Key Data Type Description Required
order_id string Must be a globally unique identifier for the order (e.g., "order_0008"). Cannot be reused if the order is deleted. ✅ Yes
order_alias string Secondary identifier for tracking in external systems (e.g., ERP or warehouse systems). ❌ No
hub_code string Code for the warehouse/fulfillment center that will handle this order. Ensure it matches a valid hub in your system. ✅ Yes
order_items object Array of items in this order. Must contain at least one item with complete product and pricing details. ✅ Yes
order_items.sku_code string Product’s unique SKU identifier, must match exactly with the product catalog. ✅ Yes
order_items.name string Product display name, used in the order summary and customer communications. ❌ No
order_items.display_price number Original product price before discounts. Used to show savings to the customer. ❌ No
order_items.selling_price number Final price charged after base discounts. Used for order calculations. ✅ Yes
order_items.is_substituted boolean Set to true if this is a substitution for the customer's original choice. Helps track substitutions. ❌ No
order_items.quantity integer Number of units ordered. Must be at least 1. Affects all price calculations. ✅ Yes
order_items.tax_percent number Tax rate for this item (e.g., 10 for 10%). Used to calculate the tax amount. ❌ No
order_items.tax number Calculated tax for this line item based on the selling price and quantity. ❌ No
order_items.unit_price number Price per unit, base price used for quantity calculations. ❌ No
order_items.subtotal number Line item total before tax and special discounts (unit_price × quantity). ❌ No
order_items.total number Final amount for the line item including all taxes and discounts. ❌ No
order_items.discount number Total discount applied to this item. ❌ No
order_items.tax_inclusive boolean If true, prices include tax. Important for tax calculations. ❌ No
billing_address object Address used for billing and tax calculations. Must be a valid physical address. ✅ Yes
billing_address.address1 string Main address line (street number and name). ✅ Yes
billing_address.address2 string Additional address details like apartment number, floor, or landmarks. ❌ No
billing_address.city string City name. Must be valid for the given state and country. ✅ Yes
billing_address.country string Full country name. Must match with country_code provided. ✅ Yes
billing_address.first_name string First name of the billing contact person. ❌ No
billing_address.last_name string Last name of the billing contact person. ❌ No
billing_address.phone string Contact number for billing issues. ❌ No
billing_address.state string Full state name. Must be valid for the given country. ❌ No
billing_address.zip string Postal code for the address. ❌ No
billing_address.state_code string Standard state/province code (e.g., "RIY" for Riyadh). ❌ No
billing_address.area string Optional area name ❌ No
billing_address.street string Optional street name ❌ No
billing_address.district string Optional district name ❌ No
billing_address.country_code string Two-letter ISO country code (e.g., "SA" for Saudi Arabia). ❌ No
billing_address.latitude number Optional GPS latitude for precise location. ❌ No
billing_address.longitude number Optional GPS longitude for precise location. ❌ No
billing_address.national_address_code string Optional national address code. ❌ No
shipping_address object Delivery address where the order will be sent. ✅ Yes
shipping_address.address1 string Primary delivery address. Must be accurate for successful delivery. ✅ Yes
shipping_address.address2 string Extra delivery instructions or landmark details. ❌ No
shipping_address.city string Delivery city. Must be within serviceable area. ✅ Yes
shipping_address.country string Delivery country name. Must match with your shipping rules. ✅ Yes
shipping_address.first_name string First name of person receiving delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.last_name string Last name of person receiving delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.phone string Contact number for delivery updates. ❌ No
shipping_address.area string Optional area name ❌ No
shipping_address.street string Optional street name ❌ No
shipping_address.district string Optional district name ❌ No
shipping_address.state string Full state name for delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.zip string Postal code for delivery location. ❌ No
shipping_address.state_code string Standard state code for delivery location. ❌ No
shipping_address.country_code string Two-letter country code for delivery location. ❌ No
shipping_address.latitude number Optional GPS latitude for precise location. ❌ No
shipping_address.longitude number Optional GPS longitude for precise location. ❌ No
shipping_address.national_address_code string Optional national address code. ❌ No
invoice object Contains all financial details and calculations for the order. ✅ Yes
invoice.currency string Three-letter currency code (e.g., "USD", "SAR"). ✅ Yes
invoice.subtotal number Sum of all item prices before tax/discounts. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_price number Delivery fee charged to customer. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_refund number Any shipping fee refunded to customer. ❌ No
invoice.tax number Total tax amount for the order. ❌ No
invoice.discount number Total order level discounts (not including item discounts). ❌ No
invoice.total number Final order amount including all items, tax, shipping, and discounts. ✅ Yes
invoice.total_paid number Amount already received from customer. ❌ No
invoice.total_due number Remaining amount to be paid. Should be 0 for prepaid orders. ❌ No
invoice.total_refunded number Total amount refunded to customer from this order. ❌ No
invoice.payment_mode string How the customer paid (e.g., "visa", "cash","mada", "credit card"). ❌ No
invoice.tax_percent number Overall tax rate applied to order. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_tax number Tax amount specifically for the shipping fee. ❌ No
invoice.sub_total_tax_inclusive boolean Whether subtotal includes tax. ❌ No
invoice.sub_total_discount_inclusive boolean Whether subtotal includes discounts. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_tax_inclusive boolean Whether shipping fee includes tax. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_discount_inclusive boolean Whether shipping fee includes discounts. ❌ No
customer object Details about who placed the order. ✅ Yes
customer.id string Unique identifier for this customer in your system. ✅ Yes
customer.first_name string Customer's first name. ✅ Yes
customer.last_name string Customer's last name. ❌ No
customer.mobile string Mobile number for updates. ❌ No
customer.mobile_code string Country calling code with + prefix. ❌ No
customer.email string Customer’s email for order confirmations. ❌ No
customer.avatar string URL to customer’s profile image. ❌ No
customer.gender string Customer's gender, if provided. ❌ No
labels array Custom tags to categorize the order. ❌ No
slot object Selected delivery time window. ❌ No
slot.delivery_date string Delivery date in DDMMYYYY format. ❌ No
slot.start_time integer Delivery window start time in HHMM format. ❌ No
slot.end_time integer Delivery window end time in HHMM format. ❌ No
payment_method string Payment method chosen (e.g., "prepaid", "postpaid","pending"). ✅ Yes
delivery_type string Delivery Types supported. (e.g., click_and_collect,
express_delivery,
slot_delivery,
normal_delivery)		 ❌ No
transactions array List of payment transactions for this order. ❌ No
transactions.transaction_id string Unique transaction ID. ❌ No
transactions.amount number Transaction amount. ❌ No
transactions.type integer Transaction type code (e.g., 1=payment, 2=refund). ❌ No
transactions.card_number string Masked card number. ❌ No
transactions.source_account string Source account for payment. ❌ No
transactions.destination_account string Destination account receiving payment. ❌ No
transactions.status integer Payment status code (e.g., 1=success, 0=pending). ❌ No
transactions.description string Human-readable explanation of the transaction. ❌ No
is_cash_on_delivery boolean Set to true if payment is collected during delivery. ✅ Yes
note string Special instructions for order handling. ❌ No
type string Order category (e.g., "b2b", "b2c"). ✅ Yes
external_fields array Custom fields for external system integration. ❌ No
external_fields.key string Custom field name for external systems. ❌ No
external_fields.value string Custom field value. ❌ No
cancel_order_after_seconds integer Order auto-cancels after this many seconds. ❌ No
attachments array List of attachments associated with the order or invoice. Each attachment should include file metadata and a publicly accessible file URL. ❌ No
attachments[].name string Display name of the attachment. ✅ Yes
attachments[].description string Short description of the attachment content. ❌ No
attachments[].url string Publicly accessible URL of the uploaded file. ✅ Yes
attachments[].mime_type string MIME type of the file, for example image/jpeg or application/pdf. ✅ Yes
attachments[].entity string Entity the attachment belongs to, such as order or invoice. ✅ Yes

✅ Notes

  • Fields marked as ✅ Yes under "Required" must be included in the request.

  • Geolocation fields (latitude, longitude) are optional but useful for delivery tracking.

  • The payment_method should match an accepted payment type in the system.

  • Ensure customer.id is valid if using an existing customer, or create a new customer by passing the required fields.

  • The order_items array must contain at least one item to process the order.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1️⃣ How do I force an order to a specific hub?

To manually route an order to a specific hub, provide the hub's unique code in the hub_code field.

Example: { "hub_code": "HUB123" }

2️⃣ What if payment details are missing?

If payment information is unavailable and you need to block shipment creation at the packing stage, set:
{ "payment_method": "pending" }

This ensures the shipment cannot be created until payment details are updated.

3️⃣ How do I create a shipment if the payment status is pending?

  • Set the payment status to "pending" when creating the order.

  • Once the invoice details are received, update the order using the Update Order Invoice API.

  • After updating the invoice, shipment creation will be enabled via the dashboard.

request.description:
Description

Cancel an existing order for a specific seller in Omniful.

This endpoint is used when an order needs to be cancelled due to customer request, incorrect product selection, or operational reasons.

Only orders in a cancellable state (e.g., not yet shipped or delivered) can be cancelled.

Path Parameters

Name Type Required Description
seller_code string Yes Unique identifier for the seller (e.g., KO-SE-2).
id string Yes Internal Omniful order ID of the order to be cancelled.

Request Body Fields

Field Type Required Description
cancel_reason string No (recommended) Human-readable explanation for why the order is being cancelled.

Notes

  • The order must be in a state that allows cancellation.

  • This operation updates the order lifecycle and triggers cancellation workflows across OMS/WMS/TMS depending on configuration.

  • If cancel_reason is not provided, the order will still be cancelled, but the reason will be stored as empty.

request.description:
📌 Update Order API - Overview

The Update Order API allows users to modify the details of an existing order that was previously placed. This API can be used to update various order attributes, such as order items, shipping details, billing information, and customer details.

Users can update an order only if it is not in the "packed" state. Once an order reaches the packed stage, further modifications using this API are restricted.

This API ensures flexibility in managing orders before final processing while maintaining data integrity after packing.

Note: The note field is always treated as part of the update. If the note key is included in the payload with an empty value or if the note key is not provided at all, it will be treated as an update with an empty note, resulting in the deletion of any previously saved note.

📝 Request Body Parameters

Field Data Type Description Required
order_id string The ID of the order you want to update. You can't change this value. Example: "order_0003". ✅ Yes
hub_code string The warehouse handling this order. Example: "Shubhra001". ✅ Yes
order_items array List of products in the order. You can update quantities, add or remove items. ✅ Yes
order_items.sku_code string The product's unique ID in your catalog. Ensure it exists before using it. ✅ Yes
order_items.name string The name that appears on the order for this product. ❌ No
order_items.display_price number The original price before any discounts. ❌ No
order_items.selling_price number The actual price charged for this item after basic discounts. ✅ Yes
order_items.is_substituted boolean Set to true if replacing the original item with something else. ❌ No
order_items.quantity integer How many of this item you want now. Must be 1 or more. ❌ No
order_items.tax_percent number The tax rate for this item (e.g., 10 for 10%). ❌ No
order_items.tax number The calculated tax amount for this item based on quantity and price. ❌ No
order_items.unit_price number Price per unit of the item. ❌ No
order_items.subtotal number Total cost before tax (unit_price × quantity). ❌ No
order_items.total number Final price including everything (tax, discounts, etc.). ❌ No
order_items.discount number How much discount is applied to this item. ❌ No
order_items.tax_inclusive boolean Set to true if prices include tax. ❌ No

billing_address.first_name string First name of the person being billed. ❌ No
billing_address.last_name string Last name of the person being billed. ❌ No
billing_address.phone string Phone number for billing questions. ❌ No
billing_address.state string State for billing. ❌ No
billing_address.zip string ZIP or postal code for billing. ❌ No
billing_address.state_code string Short code for the state (e.g., "NY" for New York). ❌ No
billing_address.country_code string Two-letter country code (e.g., "US" for United States). ❌ No
billing_address.latitude number Latitude for the address, if needed. ❌ No
billing_address.longitude number Longitude for the address, if needed. ❌ No
billing_address.national_address_code string National address code of the address, if needed. ❌ No
shipping_address.address1 string Main delivery address. ❌ No
shipping_address.city string City for delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.country string Country for delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.first_name string First name of the person receiving the package. ❌ No
shipping_address.last_name string Last name of the person receiving the package. ❌ No
shipping_address.phone string Phone number to call for delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.state string State for delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.zip string ZIP or postal code for delivery. ❌ No
shipping_address.state_code string Short code for the delivery state. ❌ No
shipping_address.country_code string Two-letter code for delivery country. ❌ No
shipping_address.latitude number Latitude for delivery location, if needed. ❌ No
shipping_address.longitude number Longitude for delivery location, if needed. ❌ No
shipping_address.national_address_code string National address code of the address, if needed. ❌ No
order_created_at string The order’s creation time. Cannot be changed. ❌ No
invoice.currency string Currency used for the order (e.g., "USD"). Cannot be changed after creation. ❌ No
invoice.subtotal number Total cost of all items before any extras. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_price number Delivery charge. ❌ No
invoice.shipping_refund number Refund for shipping issues. ❌ No
invoice.tax number Total tax for the entire order. ❌ No

⚠ Key Points to Consider When Updating Orders

  • Only orders with the status "on_hold" can be updated.

request.description:
Overview

Updates attachments for an existing order.

Use this request to add or update attachment metadata for the specified order, such as invoice or order.

Endpoint

PUT {{base_url}}/public/v1/orders/{{order_id}}/attachments

Authentication

This request uses the configured access token variable:

  • {{access_token}}

Validation Notes

  • The attachments array can contain a maximum of 10 items.

Path Parameters

Parameter Type Required Description
order_id string Yes The unique identifier of the order whose attachments need to be updated.

Request Body

The request body accepts an attachments array.

Field Type Required Description
attachments array Yes List of attachments to associate with the order.
attachments[].name string Yes Display name of the attachment.
attachments[].description string No Optional description for the attachment.
attachments[].url string Yes Public or accessible URL of the attachment file.
attachments[].mime_type string Yes MIME type of the file, such as image/jpeg or application/pdf.
attachments[].entity string Yes Logical entity the attachment belongs to, can be one of order or invoice .

item.description:
🛒 Order API Documentation

📌 Overview

This document outlines the structure of the Order API request and response, explaining the meaning, type, and purpose of each key.

📋 Order Object Structure

🔹 Order Identification

Key Type Description
order_id string Unique identifier for the order in Omniful.
order_alias string Alternative reference name assigned to the order.
hub_code string Code of the fulfillment hub responsible for processing the order.
seller_code string Unique identifier assigned to the seller.
store_name string Name of the store where the order was placed.
source string Indicates where the order originated (e.g., Sales Channel, Manual).
status_code string Current status of the order (e.g., On Hold, Shipped).

📦 Order Items

Key Type Description
order_items array List of items included in the order.
sku_code string Unique Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code for the item.
name string Product name as it appears in the store.
display_price number Original price of the item before applying any discount.
selling_price number Final price of the item after applying discounts.
quantity integer Number of units of this item ordered.
tax_percent number Tax percentage applied to this item.
tax number Total tax amount applied to the item.
unit_price number Price per unit of the item.
subtotal number Price before tax and discounts for this item.
total number Final payable amount for this item after tax and discount.

🏠 Address Information

📄 Billing Address (Customer's Payment Information)

Key Type Description
billing_address object Contains billing details of the customer.
address1 string Primary billing address.
address2 string Secondary billing address (if applicable).
city string City where the order is billed.
state string State or region of the billing address.
zip string Postal code of the billing address.
country string Country of the billing address.
phone string Customer’s phone number for billing.
national_address_code string National address code of billing address

🚚 Shipping Address (Customer’s Delivery Information)

Key Type Description
shipping_address object Contains shipping details for the order.
address1 string Primary shipping address where the order will be delivered.
address2 string Secondary shipping address (if applicable).
city string City where the order is being shipped.
state string State or region of the shipping address.
zip string Postal code of the shipping address.
country string Country of the shipping address.
phone string Customer’s phone number for shipping.
national_address_code string National address code of shipping address

🧾 Invoice Information (Order Payment Summary)

Key Type Description
invoice object Contains invoice details for the order.
currency string Currency used for this order (e.g., USD, SAR).
subtotal number Total cost of all items before tax, discounts, or shipping.
shipping_price number Shipping cost for the order.
tax number Total tax amount applied to the order.
discount number Total discount applied to the order.
total number Final payable amount including all charges.
total_paid number Amount already paid by the customer.
total_due number Remaining balance the customer needs to pay.
payment_method string Payment mode (e.g., Mada, Credit Card).

👤 Customer Details

Key Type Description
customer object Contains customer details.
first_name string Customer’s first name.
last_name string Customer’s last name.
mobile string Customer’s mobile number.
mobile_code string Country code for the mobile number.
email string Customer’s email address.

🚛 Shipment Details (Delivery Processing)

Key Type Description
shipment_type string Type of shipment (e.g., omniful_generated).
delivery_type string Type of delivery (e.g., normal_delivery).

💰 Payment Details

Key Type Description
payment_method string Payment method selected by the customer (e.g., prepaid, COD).

📝 Miscellaneous

Key Type Description
note string Additional notes or instructions related to the order.
type string The order category (e.g., b2b, RTS).

✅ Notes

  • order_id is the primary reference for tracking and retrieving orders.

  • Use Omniful Order ID instead of sales channel IDs for consistency.

  • Orders can be fetched using the Get Orders API.

For further details, refer to the Sample API Request Response Below.

request.description:
Searches tenant orders using optional filters and can return a maximum of 100 orders per request.

Method: GET
Endpoint: {{base_url}}/sales-channel/public/v2/tenants/orders/search

This request is used to retrieve orders that match the supplied search criteria. Authentication appears to be required because the request uses the available {{access_token}} variable.

This API can send a maximum of 100 orders only.

All query parameters are optional unless otherwise indicated.

Available query parameters

  • order_id: Filter by a single order ID.

  • order_ids: Filter by multiple order IDs.

  • order_alias: Filter by a single order alias.

  • order_aliases: Filter by multiple order aliases.

  • sto_request_id: Filter by stock transfer order ID.

  • created_from: Start date for filtering by order creation date. Maximum allowed value is today minus 90 days. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

  • created_to: End date for filtering by order creation date. Maximum allowed value is today. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

  • updated_from: Start date for filtering by order update date. Maximum allowed value is today minus 90 days. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

  • updated_to: End date for filtering by order update date. Maximum allowed value is today. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

  • customer_id: Filter by customer ID.

  • customer_name: Filter by customer name.

  • customer_email: Filter by customer email.

  • customer_phone_number: Filter by customer phone number.

  • status: Filter by a single order status.

  • statuses: Filter by multiple order statuses.

  • awb_number: Filter by AWB number.

  • shipment_status: Filter by shipment status.

  • seller_code: Filter by seller code.

request.description:
📌 Get Return Request API - Overview

The Get Return Request API allows users to retrieve return requests for orders based on request status, order ID, and return order ID.

📌 Filters Available:

  • order_id – Fetch return requests for a specific order.

  • status – Filter return requests by status.

  • created_from - Filter return request by date of creation

  • created_to - Filter return request by date of creation
    By default, return requests will be returned for the last 3 months only. The supported date formats are yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss and yyyy-mm-dd.

request.description:
This API returns a list of categories, each containing a list of reports. You can optionally filter to show only archived reports or only active reports.
Query Parameters

Parameter Type Required Description Example
is_archived boolean No Filter reports by archive status. If true, returns only archived reports. If false or not provided, returns only active reports. true or false

Each report has a display name, key name, and a list of filters. Each filter has information about whether it is required, its key name, data type, sample value, and options (if any).

For example, under the "Invoicing Reports" category, there is a "Seller Activity Report" which requires a "hub" and a "date_range" filter. Similarly, under the "Fulfilment Reports" category, there is an "Orders Report" which requires a "hub", "date_range", and "order_status" filter.

Archived Reports Example:
When is_archived=true, you'll see reports like "Orders Report" under "Fulfilment Reports" category. This archived report includes a "granularity" filter in the filters data that explicitly indicates the supported time granularity:

  • If the granularity filter shows "month" as an option, it's a monthly report only

The granularity filter in archived reports determines which time format you should use when downloading the report:

  • Monthly reports: Use mm-yyyy format (e.g., "12-2023")

Upon sending a GET request to the specified endpoint, you will receive a response containing the data of the supported reports. This data can be used to understand the types of reports available and the required filters for each report.

response.name: Fetch Supported Reports
Fetch Supported Archived Reports

request.description:
To use this API, you need to send a POST request to the specified endpoint with the category key name and report key name from the Fetch Supported Reports API. The request body should contain the timezone and the filters for the report. Each filter should have a key name and a value. The key names should be according to the key name given in Fetch Supported Reports API. The values for these keys should be replaced with your actual values in the same format as given in sample_values of Fetch Supported Reports API.

Upon sending this request to the Omniful API, the system will generate the report based on the provided filters and send the response to the webhook URL given in Fetch Supported Reports API.

Important points to consider:

  • Required Filters Should always be present with valid values.

  • In case options is present for particular filter in Fetch Supported Reports API . The filter value passed should be one of the key_name in options

  • The date format should always be yyy-mm-dd and the date range filter will be in format [start_date, end_date]

  • Timezone should always be passed in the request.

  • Difference between start and end date can be maximum of 7 days and first value of date_range corresponds to start_date while second value corresponds to end_date****.

  • The category in param corresponds to the key_name of category while report in param corresponds to the key_name of report in Fetch Supported Reports API

⚡ Rate Limiting

To ensure fair usage and performance stability, Omniful APIs have a default rate limit of:

✅ 30 requests per minute

📌 Exceeding the limit may result in temporary API restrictions

request.description:
Download Archived Reports

Overview

This API allows you to download archived reports with specific granularity (monthly). Archived reports contain historical data that has been moved to archive status and can be accessed for compliance or historical analysis purposes.

Endpoint

POST {{base_url}}/sales-channel/public/v1/reports/archived/:category/:report/download

Path Parameters

Parameter Type Required Description Example
category string Yes The category key name of the report fulfilment
report string Yes The report key name within the category orders

Request Body

Field Type Required Description Example
granularity string Yes The granularity level for the archived report. Must be "month". "month"
month string Conditional Required when granularity is "month". Month in mm-yyyy format "01-2024"

Authorization

Bearer Token

This request uses Bearer Token from folder Tenant APIs

item.description:
📌 Webhook Payload Reference

Overview

This section provides sample webhook payloads for all available webhooks. You can refer to these payloads to understand the structure and expected data for each event.

🔹 How to Use

  • Review the sample webhook payloads to understand the data format.

  • Use them as a reference when setting up webhook listeners in your system.

  • Ensure your application can handle incoming webhook requests and parse the payload accordingly.

For detailed webhook event descriptions and payload samples, refer to the Webhook Documentation. 🚀

⚠️ Please Note:
Each webhook request has a 30-second timeout. This means your endpoint must send a valid HTTP response within 30 seconds of receiving the request. If no response is received within this window, our system will retry the request up to 3 times before marking it as failed.

🔐 Custom Headers

Custom HTTP headers can be added to webhook events to support advanced use cases such as authentication, request routing, or internal tracking.

✨ Key Capabilities

  • Add up to 2 custom headers per webhook event

  • Each header consists of a key–value pair

  • These headers are sent with every webhook request for the configured event

📏 Constraints

Attribute Limit
Maximum custom headers 2
Header key max length 50 characters
Header value max length 4500 characters

🚫 Restricted Header Keys

For security and system integrity reasons, custom header keys must NOT use any of the following reserved headers:

x-omniful-request-id
x-omniful-channel-name
webhook-secret-key
webhook-event
tracestate
traceparent
newrelic

request.description:
Add Shipment for Return Order

This endpoint allows the user to add a shipment for a specific return order belonging to a seller.

Request Body

  • tracking_url (string) - The URL for tracking the shipment.

  • awb_number (string) - The Air Waybill (AWB) number for the shipment.

  • awb_label (string) - The URL to the AWB label for the shipment.

  • package_details (object) - Details of the package including number of boxes, weight, dimensions, and remarks.

    • number_of_boxes (integer) - The number of boxes in the shipment.

    • weight (integer) - The total weight of the shipment.

    • dimensions (object) - The dimensions of the package including length, breadth, and height.

      • length (integer) - The length of the package.

      • breadth (integer) - The breadth of the package.

      • height (integer) - The height of the package.

    • remarks (string) - Any specific remarks for handling the package.

  • courier_partner (object) - Details of the courier partner including ID, name, tag, and logo URL.

    • tag (string) - The tag associated with the courier partner.

request.description:
This API endpoint allows you to create a return order for any forward order that has been marked as Delivered.

Precondition

  • The order must have the status Delivered to be eligible for a return.

Field Descriptions

Field Type Mandatory/Optional Description
return_order_id string Mandatory Unique identifier for the return order.
return_items array of objects Mandatory List of items being returned, including item_id, sku_code, and return_quantity.
item_id string Mandatory Original order item ID.
sku_code string Mandatory SKU code of the item being returned.
return_quantity integer Mandatory Quantity of the item being returned.
return_item_id string Optional Unique ID for the returned item.
return_reasons array of objects Optional List of reasons for return, with each entry specifying reason and quantity.
unit_price float Optional Price per unit of the item.
discount float Optional Discount applied to the item.
total float Optional Total price for the returned quantity.
additional_charges array of objects Optional List of additional charges applied to the return, including the type, cost, tax_inclusive, etc.
type string Optional Type of charge, one of cod_fee, return_fee, return_shipment_fee.
cost float Optional The cost of the additional charge.
tax_inclusive boolean Optional Whether the charge includes tax.
tax_percentage float Optional Tax percentage applied to the additional charge.
is_applied boolean Optional Whether the additional charge is applied to the return.

Response

The response will include the details of the created return order, including the return order ID, return items, and any additional charges applied.

Notes

  • return_order_id and the fields inside return_items marked as mandatory must always be provided.

  • Optional fields can be included based on business requirements (e.g., specifying return reasons or applying additional charges).

request.description:
Push Hub Inventory

This endpoint allows you to update the inventory corresponding to a specific seller and hub. By providing the seller's unique code and the hub's unique code, you can modify the available quantities of skus of that seller in that hub.

This route can only be used for hubs which are location-inventory off.

Request

  • Method: PUT
  • Endpoint: {{base_url}}/sales-channel/public/v1/tenants/hubs/:hub_code/sellers/:seller_code/inventory

Request Body

The request body must be in JSON format and should contain the following structure:

{
  "sku_detail": [
    {
      "sku_code": "string",   // The unique code for the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit)
      "quantity": integer      // The quantity of the SKU to be updated in the inventory
    }
  ]
}
  • sku_detail: An array of objects, each representing a SKU and its associated quantity.
    • sku_code: A string that identifies the SKU.
    • quantity: An integer that specifies the amount of the SKU being added or updated.
  • Max 200 skus are allowed in the payload of each request.

Response

The response will typically include a confirmation of the update, along with the failed skus with reasons.

request.description:
Create Pickup Location API

Description

Creates a new pickup (hub) location for a seller. A pickup location can be physical or virtual and is used for fulfilling orders and assigning shipments.

📋 Field Descriptions

Top-Level Fields

Field Type Required Description
name string ✅ Name of the pickup location (e.g., “Main Warehouse”).
email string ✅ Contact email for the pickup location.
phone_number object ✅ Contact phone details (number, code, country).
external_hub_identifier string ✅ External system reference/ID for hub mapping.
address object ✅ Address details of the pickup location.
virtual_hub_type string ❌ If hub is virtual, specify type (e.g., virtual).

Phone Number Object

Field Type Required Description
number string ✅ Phone number of the pickup location.
country_calling_code string ❌ International calling code (e.g., +91).
country_code string ✅ ISO 2-letter country code (e.g., IN).

Address Object

Field Type Required Description
address_1 string ✅ Primary address line (e.g., street, plot).
address_2 string ❌ Secondary address line (e.g., suite, floor).
postal_code string ✅ Postal/ZIP code.
city_name string ❌ City where hub is located.
state_name string ❌ State/Province name.
country_name string ✅ Country name.
country_code string ✅ ISO 2-letter country code.
state_code string ❌ State code (if applicable).
latitude number ❌ Latitude coordinates for hub geolocation.
longitude number ❌ Longitude coordinates for hub geolocation.
national_address_code string ❌ National address code for hub.

request.description:
Description

📦 Create Shipment Order API

📥 Request Body

1. Order Information

Field Type Required Description
display_order_id string ✅ Unique human-readable order ID shown in Omniful.
client_reference_id string ❌ Client-provided reference ID for internal tracking.
automatic_shipment_order_shipment_enabled boolean ❌ If true, shipment order will auto-generate a shipment.
order_created_at string (ISO 8601) ❌ Date-time when the order was originally created.
slot.delivery_date string (YYYY-MM-DD) ❌ Requested delivery date.
slot.start_time number (HHMM) ❌ Delivery start time in 24-hour HHMM format (e.g., 1000 = 10:00 AM).
slot.end_time number (HHMM) ❌ Delivery end time in 24-hour HHMM format.
note string ❌ Special instructions (e.g., “Handle with care”).
labels[] array of strings ❌ Tags/labels for internal classification (e.g., fragile, priority).
product_description string ❌ High-level description of order contents.

2. Order Items

Field Type Required Description
item_id string ❌ Unique identifier for the item in the order.
sku_code string ✅ SKU code linked to catalog.
hs_code string ❌ Harmonized System code for customs classification.
sku_id string ❌ SKU ID mapped in Omniful.
name string ❌ Display name of the item.
display_price number ❌ Original display price before discounts.
selling_price number ❌ Final selling price of the item.
quantity number ❌ Quantity ordered.
unit_price number ❌ Unit price per item.
sub_total number ❌ Subtotal before taxes & discounts.
total number ❌ Final total after adjustments.
discount number ❌ Discount applied on item.
discount_percent number ❌ Discount percentage.
tax_percent number ❌ Tax percentage applied.
tax number ❌ Tax amount applied.
tax_inclusive boolean ❌ Whether prices are tax-inclusive.
is_substituted boolean ❌ If item was substituted for another.
item_barcodes[] array ❌ List of barcodes for the item.
sku object ❌ Full SKU details.

sku object fields

Field Type Description
id string SKU unique ID.
code string SKU code.
name string SKU name.
type string SKU type (e.g., physical, digital).
images[] array List of image URLs for SKU (default, thumbnail, medium, large, url, type, description).

3. Customer Information

Field Type Required Description
id string ❌ Customer ID if already exists.
first_name string ❌ Customer’s first name.
last_name string ❌ Customer’s last name.
mobile string ❌ Customer’s phone number.
mobile_code string ❌ Mobile code (e.g., +91).
country_code string ❌ Country ISO code.
email string ❌ Customer’s email.
gender string ❌ Gender (male/female/other).
country string ❌ Customer’s country name.
country_calling_code string ❌ Country calling code.

4. Shipment Information

Field Type Required Description
shipment.number_of_boxes number ❌ Number of boxes in shipment.
shipment.weight number ❌ Weight of shipment (kg).
shipment_type string ❌ Type of shipment (e.g., omniful_generated, external).
delivery_type string ❌ Delivery type (e.g., doorstep, click_and_collect).
no_of_boxes number ❌ Number of boxes (duplicate of shipment.number_of_boxes).

5. Address Information

Receiver Address

Field Type Required Description
address1 string ✅ Primary address line.
address2 string ❌ Secondary address line.
city string ✅ City.
state string ❌ State/Province.
zip string ❌ Postal code.
country string ❌ Country name.
country_code string ❌ ISO country code.
state_code string ❌ State code.
latitude number ❌ Latitude coordinates.
longitude number ❌ Longitude coordinates.
first_name string ❌ Contact first name.
last_name string ❌ Contact last name.
phone string ❌ Contact phone number.
email string ❌ Contact email.
country_calling_code string ❌ Country calling code.
national_address_code string ❌ National address code.

6. Hub Details

Field Type Required Description
code string ✅ Hub code assigned in Omniful.
hub_type string ❌ Type of hub (physical/virtual).
virtual_hub_type string ❌ Virtual hub type (e.g., pickup_location).

7. Payment Information

This API allows you to obtain a new access token and refresh token using a refresh token grant type. Access tokens are short-lived tokens that grant access to specific resources or actions within an API, while refresh tokens are used to request new access tokens without requiring the user to re-authenticate.

Upon sending this request to the Omniful API, you will receive a response containing the new access token and refresh token, which you can then use to access protected resources and perform authorized actions on behalf of the authenticated user.

📌 Introduction to Tenant APIs

Overview

Omniful introduces Tenant APIs, enabling users to create custom integrations that operate at the tenant level instead of the seller level. These APIs will provide you with a centralized way to manage operations across multiple sellers, and ensure seamless automation and control at a higher organizational level.

🔹 Key Benefits

  • Scalability → You can now perform operations across all sellers under a single tenant.

  • Centralized Management → Manage configurations, workflows, and data at the tenant level for all your sellers.

  • Seamless Integrations → Develop custom applications using Omniful APIs that extend Omniful’s functionality to your software.

🔹 What Can You Do with Tenant-Level APIs?

  • Create and manage tenant-wide integrations.

  • Gain insights into aggregated analytics and reporting.

With Tenant-Level APIs, users gain greater control, flexibility, and efficiency in managing their operations within Omniful.

Getting Started with Tenant Custom Integration

First, you need to have Tenant Custom Integration created in your Omniful dashboard.

  • Log in to your Omniful dashboard.

  • Navigate to: Settings → Apps & Integrations → Custom Apps → Tenant Custom Integration

  • Simply click the Integrate / View details button.

Note: Enabling tenant custom integration is a permanent action and cannot be reversed once completed.

Note: For all operations in the KSA region, the national_address_code field must be included inside every request’s address object. This is mandatory across all APIs in this folder.

Post-Integration Access

After successful integration, you’ll get access to the following in three consecutive tabs within the Omniful dashboard:

  • Configuration : Manage authentication credentials and essential integration settings.

  • Hub Mappings : Select which hubs are enabled or disabled for this integration.

  • Order Status Mappings : Enable or disable order statuses that should trigger webhooks.

⚡ Rate Limiting

To ensure fair usage and performance stability, Omniful APIs have a default rate limit of:

✅ 120 requests per minute

📌 Exceeding the limit may result in temporary API restrictions.

Refer to the API documentation below for detailed endpoints and usage guidelines. 🚀

⚠️ Error Responses

Status Code Error Code Description
400 BadRequest / InvalidRequest Invalid path parameters, query parameters or body.
401 Unauthorized Missing or invalid authentication token
403 Forbidden You are not authorized to perform this action
429 TooManyRequests Rate limit exceeded
500 InternalServerError Internal server error

📦 Shipment API Documentation

📌 Create Shipment– Overview

The Create Shipment API allows users to initiate and register a new shipment for an order or set of packages. This API enables sellers, logistics partners, and system integrators to define shipment details such as pickup location, delivery destination, package dimensions, product information, and service type.

It is useful for automating the shipping process, ensuring accurate order fulfillment, and integrating with logistics partners for real-time tracking. This API streamlines operational workflows by enabling batch creation of shipments, reducing manual effort, and ensuring shipments are ready for pickup or delivery according to business requirements.

Shipment Object

Key Data Type Description Required
reference_id string A unique identifier for the shipment in your system. Used to map to the related order. Required
seller_hub_code string Code of the hub/warehouse from which the shipment will be dispatched. Must match a valid hub. Conditional (else seller_hub_info is requried)
seller_hub_info struct Information of the seller hub for which shipment need to be created, hub either can exists or will be created Conditional (else seller_hub_code is requried)
product_type string Type of product being shipped (physical_product, customer_service). Required
service_type string Type of logistics service (standard, express, scheduled). Required
shipment_type string Indicates the shipment direction (forward, reverse). Required
pickup_type string Defines how shipment is picked up (pickup_by_logistics, pickup_by_party). Required
delivery_type string Defines how shipment is delivered (delivery_by_logistics, pickup_by_party). Required
handling_granularity string Shipment handling granularity (package, item). Required
payment_info object Payment and declared value information for the shipment. Optional
customer_info object Details about the receiver of the shipment. Required
delivery_preference object Delivery preference details. Optional
sales_channel_info object Details about the seller/shipper’s sales channel. Optional
packages array List of packages included in the shipment. Required

Payment Info (Object)

Key Data Type Description Required / Conditional
currency string Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., SAR, USD). Conditional
payment_type string Payment method (prepaid, postpaid). Conditional
declared_value number Value declared for insurance and customs. Conditional
total_due number Shipping fee charged to the customer (if any). Conditional
total_paid number Cash-on-delivery amount (if payment_type = postpaid). Conditional

Customer Info (Object)

Key Data Type Description Required / Conditional
code string Unique identifier of the customer. Optional
name string Full name of the customer. Optional
email string Customer’s email address. Conditional
phone string Customer’s phone number for delivery updates. Conditional
country_code string ISO 2-letter country code (e.g., SA, AE). Conditional
address object Full delivery address (street, building, landmarks). Optional

Seller Hub Info (Object)

Key Data Type Description Required
name string Name of the seller hub. Required
hub_code string Unique identifier for the hub. Required
email string Email address of the hub contact. Optional
phone string Contact phone number of the hub. Required
country_calling_code string International calling code of the phone number. Required
address object Address details of the seller hub. Required

Address (object)

Key Data Type Description Required
code string Unique identifier of the address. Optional
address_line_1 string First line of the delivery address (e.g., street, building). Required
address_line_2 string Second line (apartment, suite, etc.). Optional
city string City of the delivery address. Conditional
state string State/province of the delivery address. Optional
postal_code string Postal/ZIP code. Optional
country string Country (ISO standard). Conditional
country_code string ISO 2-letter country code of the address. Conditional
city_id string Internal reference ID for the city. Conditional
state_id string Internal reference ID for the state. Optional
country_id string Internal reference ID for the country. Conditional
latitude number Latitude coordinate. Optional
longitude number Longitude coordinate. Optional

Validation Rules

  • Provide either city_id OR city.

  • Provide one of the following for country: country_id OR country_code OR country.

Note

latitude and longitude are optional but recommended for better address visibility and accurate location mapping.

Delivery Preference (Object)

Key Data Type Description Required
delivery_date string Preferred delivery date. Optional
start_time string Preferred delivery window start time. Optional
end_time string Preferred delivery window end time. Optional
delivery_instruction string Special instructions for delivery. Optional

Sales Channel Info (Object)

Key Data Type Description Required
seller_sales_channel_id string Unique identifier of the seller. Optional
sales_channel object Sales channel/store information. Optional
sales_channel.id string Unique ID of the sales channel. Optional
sales_channel.tag string Short code/tag of the sales channel. Optional
sales_channel.name string Name of the sales channel/store. Optional
sales_channel.category string Category (marketplace, retail, etc.). Optional
sales_channel.logo_url string Logo of the sales channel (URL). Optional
sales_channel.link string Store URL. Optional
sales_channel.store_name string Store name in the sales channel. Optional

Packages (Array)

Key Data Type Description Required
reference_id string Unique identifier of the package. Optional
payment_info object Payment info specific to this package. Required
packaging_info object Dimensions and weight of the package. Required
items array List of items inside the package. Optional

Package Payment Info

Key Data Type Description Required
currency string ISO currency code (e.g., SAR, USD). Required
payment_type string Payment method (prepaid, postpaid). Required
declared_value number Declared value of the package (> 0). Required
total_due number Shipping fee charged for the package. Optional
total_paid number COD amount for the package. Optional

Packaging Info

Key Data Type Description Required
weight number Package weight (kg). Required
length number Package length (cm). Optional
width number Package width (cm). Optional
height number Package height (cm). Optional
volume number Package volume (cc³). Optional

Items (Array)

Key Data Type Description Required / Conditional
item_id string Unique identifier of the item. Conditional
sku object SKU details of the product. Optional
quantity integer Quantity of the item inside the package. Conditional
return_reason string Reason for return (if return shipment). Conditional
note string Additional notes about the item. Optional
image_urls array List of image URLs of the item. Optional

SKU (Object)

Key Data Type Description Required / Conditional
id string Unique ID of the SKU. Conditional
name string Name of the product. Conditional
code string SKU code. Conditional
description string Description of the product. Optional
image_urls array List of product image URLs. Optional
barcodes array List of barcodes for the SKU. Optional
weight number Weight of a single unit (kg). Conditional
currency string Currency of the product’s selling price. Conditional
selling_price number Selling price per unit. Conditional

Enum Explanations

Product Type

  • physical_product → Tangible item that must be physically shipped, stored, packed, and delivered.

  • customer_service → A service provided to the customer instead of a physical item.

Service Type

  • standard → Regular delivery option, cost-effective.

  • express → Faster delivery option (same day/next day).

  • scheduled → Delivery happens on a specific date and time slot chosen by the customer.

Shipment Type

  • forward → Normal flow: seller/warehouse → customer.

  • reverse → Opposite flow: customer → seller/warehouse (returns, exchanges, recalls).

Pickup Type

  • pickup_by_logistics → Courier/3PL picks up the shipment from the seller.

  • pickup_by_party → The seller or customer drops off the shipment themselves.

Delivery Type

  • delivery_by_logistics → Courier delivers shipment to the customer.

  • pickup_by_party → Customer or vendor collects the shipment directly.

Handling Granularity

  • item → Each product/item is tracked and managed individually.

  • package → The shipment is tracked as a whole package/parcel.

📌 Note:

  • If handling_granularity = item, then packages object is mandatory, and each package must contain at least one item inside packages.items.

  • physical_product → Tangible item that must be physically shipped, stored, packed, and delivered.

  • customer_service → A service provided to the customer instead of a physical item.

Service Type

  • standard → Regular delivery option, cost-effective.

  • express → Faster delivery option (same day/next day).

  • scheduled → Delivery happens on a specific date and time slot chosen by the customer.

Shipment Type

  • forward → Normal flow: seller/warehouse → customer.

  • reverse → Opposite flow: customer → seller/warehouse (returns, exchanges, recalls).

Pickup Type

  • pickup_by_logistics → Courier/3PL picks up the shipment from the seller.

  • pickup_by_party → The seller or customer drops off the shipment themselves.

Delivery Type

  • delivery_by_logistics → Courier delivers shipment to the customer.

  • pickup_by_party → Customer or vendor collects the shipment directly.

Handling Granularity

  • item → Each product/item is tracked and managed individually.

  • package → The shipment is tracked as a whole package/parcel.

📌 Note:

  • If handling_granularity = item, then packages object is mandatory, and each package must contain at least one item inside packages.items.

request.description:
📌 Fetch Shipment by Shipment ID– Overview

The Fetch Shipment by Shipment ID API delivers complete shipment details using the system-generated Shipment ID. This API ensures accurate retrieval of shipment records directly tied to the internal database.

Response Body Format

Field Data Type Description
is_success boolean Indicates if the request was successful.
status_code number HTTP status code of the response.
data.shipment.id string Unique shipment identifier.
data.shipment.awb_number string The Airway Bill number for the shipment.
data.shipment.awb_label string The URL for the AWB label.
data.shipment.reference_id string The external reference ID for the shipment.
data.shipment.tracking_number string Tracking number assigned by the logistics partner.
data.shipment.seller_hub_id string ID of the seller's fulfillment hub.
data.shipment.pickup_hub_id string ID of the hub where the shipment was picked up.
data.shipment.status string Current status of the shipment.
data.shipment.source string Source of the shipment (e.g., sales_channel).
data.shipment.seller_customer_id string ID of the customer associated with the seller.
data.shipment.product_type string Type of product (e.g., physical_product).
data.shipment.service_type string Type of delivery service (e.g., standard).
data.shipment.pickup_type string Method of pickup (e.g., pickup_by_logistics).
data.shipment.delivery_type string Method of delivery (e.g., delivery_by_logistics).
data.shipment.handling_granularity string Level of handling (e.g., package).
data.shipment.shipment_type string Type of shipment (e.g., forward).
data.shipment.delivered_at string Timestamp when the shipment was delivered.
data.shipment.cancel_reason string Reason for the shipment's cancellation.
data.shipment.shipment_created_at string Timestamp when the shipment was created.
data.shipment.seller_info.name string Seller's name.
data.shipment.seller_info.code string Seller's unique code.
data.shipment.seller_info.email string Seller's email address.
data.shipment.seller_hub.name string Seller hub's name.
data.shipment.seller_hub.code string Seller hub's code.
data.shipment.seller_hub.address.address_line_1 string Primary address line of the seller hub.
data.shipment.seller_hub.address.address_line_2 string Secondary address line of the seller hub.
data.shipment.seller_hub.address.city string City of the seller hub.
data.shipment.seller_hub.address.state string State/province of the seller hub.
data.shipment.seller_hub.address.country string Country of the seller hub.
data.shipment.seller_hub.address.country_code string Two-letter country code.
data.shipment.seller_hub.address.postal_code string Postal code of the seller hub.
data.shipment.seller_hub.address.latitude number Latitude of the seller hub.
data.shipment.seller_hub.address.longitude number Longitude of the seller hub.
data.shipment.seller_hub.address.national_address_code string National Address Code of the hub.
data.shipment.customer_info.id string Unique customer identifier.
data.shipment.customer_info.name string Customer's full name.
data.shipment.customer_info.email string Customer's email address.
data.shipment.customer_info.country_code string Customer's country code.
data.shipment.customer_info.phone string Customer's phone number.
data.shipment.customer_info.address.address_line_1 string Primary address line of the customer.
data.shipment.customer_info.address.address_line_2 string Secondary address line of the customer.
data.shipment.customer_info.address.city string City of the customer.
data.shipment.customer_info.address.state string State/province of the customer.
data.shipment.customer_info.address.country string Country of the customer.

item.description:
📌 Webhook Documentation

Webhooks allow your system to receive real-time notifications when specific events occur (e.g., shipment created, shipment cancelled, status updated). Instead of polling APIs repeatedly, webhooks push data to your endpoint as soon as the event happens.

🔗 Endpoint Information

  • URL: YOUR_WEBHOOK_URL_HERE

  • Method: POST

  • Content-Type: application/json

🚀 Webhook Events and Shipment And Packages Statuses

The webhook sends a POST request to the specified URL with a JSON payload for each event.
The event_name field indicates the type of event, and the status field in the data object provides the current status of the shipment.

📦 Shipment Statuses

event_name status Description
shipment.create.event new A new shipment has been created in the system.
shipment.update.event dispatched The shipment has been picked up by the courier.
shipment.update.event in_transit The shipment is moving between logistic hubs.
shipment.update.event out_for_delivery The shipment is with the courier for final delivery.
shipment.update.event delivered The shipment has been successfully delivered.
shipment.update.event cancelled The shipment has been cancelled by the user or system.
shipment.update.event partially_delivered The shipment has been partially_delivered where some packages are delivered and some are returened to origin.
shipment.update.event returned The shipment is being returned to the sender.

📦 Package Statuses

Status Value Description
New new Shipment has been created but not yet processed.
ArrivingAtHub arriving_at_hub Shipment is on its way to a logistics hub.
ToBePicked to_be_picked Shipment is ready and waiting to be picked up by courier.
InTransit in_transit Shipment is moving between logistic hubs.
PickupRejected pickup_rejected Pickup attempt was rejected by courier or warehouse.
ArrivedAtHub arrived_at_hub Shipment has reached a logistics hub.
ReceivedAtHub received_at_hub Shipment has been received and processed at the hub.
ReadyToDispatch ready_to_dispatch Shipment is prepared for dispatch to next destination.
OutForDelivery out_for_delivery Shipment is with courier for final delivery.
Returned returned Shipment is being returned to the sender.
Delivered delivered Shipment has been successfully delivered.
Cancelled cancelled Shipment has been cancelled by user or system.
ReturningToHub returning_to_hub Shipment is on its way back to the logistics hub.
